      return;
    }

    // Apply only for screen widths smaller than 1024px

      lastScrollY = currentScrollY;

  });

<script>
  // --- Helper to get Piano token from x-pp-piano-token cookie ---
  function getPianoTokenFromCookie() {
    const cookieName = "x-pp-piano-token";
    const cookies = document.cookie.split(";").map((c) => c.trim());
    for (let c of cookies) {
      if (c.startsWith(cookieName + "=")) {
        return decodeURIComponent(c.substring(cookieName.length + 1));
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  // --- Now initialize Piano when ready ---
  var tp = window.tp || [];
  tp.push([
    "init",
    function () {
      function getQueryParam(param) {
        const paramsString = window.location.search;
        const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(paramsString);
        return searchParams.has(param) ? searchParams.get(param) : null;
      }

      function referrerAllowsLogin() {
        const ref = document.referrer;
        return !ref || ref.includes("post-gazette.com");
      }

      function hasUtmCampaign() {
        return new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).has("utm_campaign");
      }

      const token = getPianoTokenFromCookie();
      const fromApp = getQueryParam("from_app") === "1";
      const tokenExists = token !== null;
      const utmCampaignPresent = hasUtmCampaign();

      function canLoginWithToken() {
        if (utmCampaignPresent) {
          console.log(
            "loginWithToken blocked: utm_campaign parameter present in URL.",
          );
          return false;
        }
        if (!referrerAllowsLogin()) {
          console.log(
            "loginWithToken blocked: referrer does not allow loginWithToken.",
          );
          return false;
        }
        return true;
      }

      if (fromApp) {
        if (tp.pianoId.isUserValid()) {
          try {
            const currentToken = tp.pianoId.getToken();
            if (tokenExists) {
              if (currentToken === token) {
                console.log(
                  "User is already logged in with the same token. No action needed.",
                );
              } else {
                console.log(
                  "Token mismatch detected. Logging out and re-authenticating.",
                );
                tp.pianoId
                  .logout()
                  .then(function () {
                    if (canLoginWithToken()) {
                      loginWithToken(token);
                    }
                  })
                  .catch(function (error) {
                    console.log("Error during logout", error);
                  });
              }
            }
          } catch (error) {
            console.log("Error retrieving current user token", error);
          }
        } else if (tokenExists) {
          if (canLoginWithToken()) {
            loginWithToken(token);
          }
        } else {
          console.log("x-pp-piano-token cookie not found.");
        }
      }

      function loginWithToken(token) {
        tp.pianoId
          .loginByToken(token)
          .then(function () {
            console.log("User logged in with token:", token);
            location.reload();
          })
          .catch(function (error) {
            console.log("Error logging in with token", error);
          });
      }
    },
  ]);
</script>

Morris appeared surprised to learn from Allegheny County homicide detectives that he’d killed a police officer on Feb. 6, 2023.","type":"text"},{"_id":"XX53ZSI57NFSNJWF42KSWLOKA4","additional_properties":{},"content":"Morris — still hospitalized three days after the deadly shooting in McKeesport that killed Officer Sean Sluganski and wounded Officer Chuck Thomas Jr. — was polite, often calling lead detective Patrick Kinavey “sir.” He told the detectives he’d been having a good day.","type":"text"},{"_id":"QNTXF5RZVFCMZJSSBWM55EN3T4","additional_properties":{},"content":"“Johnathan, I mean, whether you know or not, you know you shot one of the police officers, right?” Kinavey asked.","type":"text"},{"_id":"BOQWFJZVZNHJBENIR2ESCLM7JA","additional_properties":{},"content":"“I’m sorry about that,” Morris said.","type":"text"},{"_id":"6XXKXGAK2NGQDAYYWJPE7Z4DWM","additional_properties":{},"content":"Kinavey continued: “And you know you shot the second officer as well — you shot two officers. One of the officers died.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"S3CGFD62LFCITDVWEPF7LBLR4E","additional_properties":{},"content":"“Whoa,” Morris said, and then continued in a rush: “There’s no way I could have shot any officers, literally, because I shot at the car twice.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"KMYMEBZXZNEERCF7CGD7KVEUHI","additional_properties":{},"content":"“And then you fired three more times,” Kinavey said. “I’m telling you what’s up — there’s video.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"4JYWAQZFDBG3FIIPKGDJ63UZ4E","additional_properties":{},"content":"Morris crossed himself, and sat with his head in his hand for several long seconds.","type":"text"},{"_id":"5NZOBCIXKZAZTIV3UREAUXVVZM","additional_properties":{},"content":"“There would be no way possible that I shot a cop — no way possible, no way,” he said. “There’s absolutely no way possible that I shot anybody.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"BJZ5M4M6X5B25PGLW67RNS2PVI","additional_properties":{},"content":"The roughly half-hour interview was among the final pieces of evidence prosecutors in the homicide case against Morris presented to jurors on Tuesday, the sixth day of testimony in the case. In it, Morris recounted what he believed happened the day, noting that he’d “blacked out” several times throughout the incident.","type":"text"},{"_id":"SRDJT5K4YRHT5LTLZEEJS7D6PQ","additional_properties":{},"content":"Defense attorney Carmen Robinson focused her cross examination of Kinavey on what he thought of Morris’ mental state during the interview. He told her that Morris was responsive and coherent.","type":"text"},{"_id":"WRD5RGBWFRAYBEB7ZDZJ5KT4DE","additional_properties":{},"content":"Sluganski and Thomas had initially responded that afternoon to a domestic violence call from Morris’ mother, former McKeesport officer Candace Tyler. She said he was being violent and suffering from PTSD. She asked for medics to assist with obtaining an involuntary commitment, but the call taker told her police had to respond to such calls.","type":"text"},{"_id":"6BFQFDWUFZCLVNK4LLY3RHQGMA","additional_properties":{},"content":"In the interview with detectives, Morris said he had no idea anyone called 911, and he claimed that his mother was the one who attacked him as he searched for a satchel he believed she’d stolen. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"3ODZOVMUXVDZNM5DQRHH66ASYI","additional_properties":{},"content":"Morris said he shrugged off the officers when they asked him to come with them. Then, he said, he blacked out. When he came to, he was at the bottom of a hill, and police were still following him.","type":"text"},{"_id":"YDAAY6YSG5DGNMZEVWFM2BTFTA","additional_properties":{},"content":"“I black out again, and whenever I come back to life, I’m on top of that damn police getting dragged by a police car,” he said, noting that he looked inside and saw a cop who’d been following him “for some time.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"ZYLAFREFNRDGZAFEEETBGE4TPM","additional_properties":{},"content":"When he tried to run away, he said, Thomas tried to “smash him” between the car and the small hillside in front of 1300 Grandview Ave. Morris said he pulled out his pistol because he saw “the other officer pull out his pistol.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"OQXCSYP2YJENNNJ6YXK4Q7KHTI","additional_properties":{},"content":"“I’m scared man, I’m like, ‘what the [expletive]?’ When I looked up and I pull out my pistol —” he paused mid-sentence, then continued: “Actually, my brother was there, too. … Actually, I [saw] all three of them.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"RIK37OUQ7VBBJLLZURUR57YK6A","additional_properties":{},"content":"He said he believed his brother would help him. Instead, he alleged, they cheered for the police to “get him.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"S7OZHWACOBGYVL73ZC7HC3QM3A","additional_properties":{},"content":"Morris referred to Thomas throughout the interview as “the Black officer” and Sluganski, who was on foot for the tail end of the pursuit, “the white officer.” He alleged he saw Sluganski pull his gun, at which point, “I fired mine, just warning shots, like ‘Hey dude, I’m [expletive] scared.’”","type":"text"},{"_id":"FIUFPCLGN5GANN73Z3OAOENY7E","additional_properties":{},"content":"Kinavey asked him if he fired anymore at either Thomas or Sluganski.","type":"text"},{"_id":"7EZIJK4KU5ESPKXZW3BJ4GNX3E","additional_properties":{},"content":"“No, I’m not trying [to] hurt nobody,” he said.","type":"text"},{"_id":"4VRM5E63Y5BTNNY4SEQQNM5D7I","additional_properties":{},"content":"After that, Morris said, he ran, realized he’d been shot, and collapsed in a parking lot a block away. He encountered two men who’d come out of the adjacent auto shop and were trying to help him when another officer pulled up to the scene.","type":"text"},{"_id":"PQ264NLRJVDIXEIUB47IK55WJM","additional_properties":{},"content":"Morris claimed he could tell from Lt. Robert Eastman’s demeanor “that he wasn’t hearing [expletive].” When Eastman pulled his gun, he said, he thought, “Damn bro, this is it for me.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"HK73ZSNH3JBQXO5NVL7M5JQJNE","additional_properties":{},"content":"“So I had to start firing at the cop,” he said, then rolled away as Eastman continued to fire.","type":"text"},{"_id":"253WPGT4PZCFZFFPWLQYDFOMUQ","additional_properties":{},"content":"Later, Kinavey asked how many times he shot at Eastman. Morris said he thought twice. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"V35RF2VWBVB6JISDWEUFZPEHQU","additional_properties":{},"content":"“If it wasn’t one, it was two.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"ENTURD7P3RCQTEBZCE2PESSA7U","additional_properties":{},"content":"About 17 minutes into the interview is when Kinavey informed Morris he’d shot Thomas in the car and killed Sluganski on the hillside.","type":"text"},{"_id":"T5H3N7ATZJCHJGRFABGT5D272U","additional_properties":{},"content":"“I didn’t shoot at him. I did not shoot at him. I literally shot two bullets at the officer —” Kinavey cut him off and told him he shot five times.","type":"text"},{"_id":"I2OIOQV4XZBH5EDAU7CAICEO5I","additional_properties":{},"content":"“I didn’t shoot five,” Morris said, and Kinavey told him, “100% you shot five.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"ECH2Z6IYD5CF5DSKWRMWIYXDKY","additional_properties":{},"content":"“I did?” Morris asked. “Damn. I must have blacked out for real. Damn.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"LHTSEA5VLZBTDDFQMH56GWJ6OU","additional_properties":{},"content":"After a few more questions, the detectives ended the interview. Morris was quiet.","type":"text"},{"_id":"ZUNU75IJJ5CNHPCI6TAOPNQACU","additional_properties":{},"content":"“I’m sorry for that cop’s family,” he said.","type":"text"},{"_id":"XIDV57TWORBP7PWFHEJJ2SSJYY","additional_properties":{},"content":"Defense attorneys moved for a judgement of acquittal from Common Pleas Judge Bruce Beemer on all counts, which is a normal move for the defense after the prosecution rests its case. He denied the motion.","type":"text"},{"_id":"ONG2KTTW4RGIXACWMB4TXQ7V74","additional_properties":{},"content":"Robinson called just two brief witnesses Tuesday afternoon, both of whom had already testified: Kinavey and ACPD Det. James Fitzgerald. At its December meeting, the P3 board is expected to discuss the proposal, which has been undergoing expedited review by PennDOT.","type":"text"},{"_id":"WRCJ7YOZ3JHQFE4LKFOX3ZVN5I","additional_properties":{},"content":"“We’re pushing for it,” the mayor said in an interview after the event. “That could be a real game-changer for Pittsburgh.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"ZWVVH5GA3NGJJMMMKLCB4UPWEI","additional_properties":{},"content":"The P3 program is designed to encourage grouping projects under one contractor or set of contractors to reduce costs through economies of scale. It can authorize public-private partnerships under two programs, projects proposed by PennDOT for contractors to bid on or projects proposed by private companies for consideration by the state. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"2DYPKOUVQ5DN7ANSZPFTZE3V6A","additional_properties":{},"content":"For example, about 10 years ago, the state contracted with Plenary Walsh Keystone Partners on a five-year Rapid Bridge Replacement Program to replace more than 550 small bridges with similar designs for $942 million. Under the umbrella of the World Health Organization, PAHO ruled on Tuesday in agreement with the commission.","type":"text"},{"_id":"SRMX33K75ZEJRMPI6EBHADLGIY","additional_properties":{},"content":"“The commission concluded that the endemic measles transmission has now been reestablished in Bolivia, Mexico and the U.S., and they recommended the measles elimination status be withdrawn, a recommendation I have accepted,” said Jarbas Barbosa, director of PAHO, in a press briefing. “The current situation requires urgent attention.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"KCAWGUWCNBF55HDSIB7IWJPI2Q","additional_properties":{},"content":"Losing elimination status means measles is considered endemic — or continuously transmitted — throughout the Americas. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"6KE3IVL2IZCFRBXIUOY6TQHCOQ","additional_properties":{},"content":"Measles becoming endemic throughout the U.S. increases the risk that members of the public, especially those who are not vaccinated against the disease, are exposed to and harmed by the highly contagious virus.","type":"text"},{"_id":"IXR4TCWXUFGNFLMAS6QAHCKWSY","additional_properties":{},"content":"Pennsylvania remains the leading state for measles transmission in an outbreak stretching into month eight. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"6TZ6X3RQLZBERGI234BCV5UENA","additional_properties":{},"content":"Khan, alongside assistant GM Andy Weidl, wanted a team that would dominate the line of scrimmage on both sides of the ball — and that has been reflected in their recent draft classes and offseason signings.","type":"text"},{"_id":"J345ZHWSMNACPKEX3XW757SB3I","additional_properties":{},"content":"“I said it in my first year I got here. We want to be able to impose our will on people and be able to break them in the second half of games,” Weidl said in August.","type":"text"},{"_id":"NN543DJBAVCQBHTHCKI3SD233E","additional_properties":{},"content":"Weidl specifically has talked about building a roster that “travels” — one that plays just as well on the road as it does at home. That part has yet to come to fruition. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"Y7KBCSCRANHZHMNULGQGZMS62Q","additional_properties":{},"content":"The Steelers’ home/road splits are staggeringly different. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"4CTVNOJ73BHMNORFV4XSC4DEIE","additional_properties":{},"content":"They are 4-0 at home, average nearly 28 points per game on offense and give up 17 per game at Acrisure Stadium. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"PF56LXJMWBC4LJ7AMBE45QXLAA","additional_properties":{},"content":"On the road, they’re 2-3, score just 17 per game and allow nearly 23 per game. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"ABLREB7YI5FFFBLR7M2ZNT3VNE","additional_properties":{},"content":"Looking at those numbers, the Steelers were lucky to win twice away from home. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"PRKXOG6OSRESHOVXV7WEE46YDU","additional_properties":{},"content":"The good news for the Steelers is they remain in good position to earn a playoff berth. The bad news is they exhibit none of the qualities that translate to winning playoff games on the road. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"W5WL7YJBQJAMTDDENVXNSSZSZU","additional_properties":{},"content":"Anything can happen over the final two months of the season, but the Steelers appear destined to go on the road if they make the playoffs. The Cincinnati Bengals lead the AFC North by one game — and they have the easiest schedule in the NFL the rest of the way. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"RHUZZ67LWBDVNH4APVNB2R7VTI","additional_properties":{},"content":"The Steelers, meanwhile, are currently the AFC’s No. 6 seed and would have to play on the road in the wild-card round if the Bengals don’t give up the division lead. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"2WCQSBI6CVETRG45QMHTLOGWBE","additional_properties":{},"content":"Coach Mike McCarthy better figure out something soon because the Steelers play another road game Sunday in Philadelphia, where they’ve lost 11 straight. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"WHLE2QLKM5G3RKMVAPYXRKLVPY","additional_properties":{},"content":"A team that can win on the road can run the ball in any environment, but the Steelers have not shown an ability to control the line of scrimmage away from Acrisure Stadium. They average 131 rushing yards in home games but just 60 yards per game on the road. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"WXZQBXZKOZEQDBC2CGURD2Y2KE","additional_properties":{},"content":"Overall, they’re averaging 90 yards fewer per game on the road. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"T6MDUNSDPNDKTNPD63IPRWSYXA","additional_properties":{},"content":"“We have to start faster,” left tackle Troy Fautanu said. “The biggest thing I see is if you don’t get that first first down on that first drive, it’s a three-and-out, and that’s not helping our defense.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"4CBDNTZWHFC7XJRBTZ2BUX4TBE","additional_properties":{},"content":"On Sunday, the Steelers could not run the ball when it mattered against a Bengals team that entered the game 25th in the league in total defense. Most of their 102 rushing yards came in the fourth quarter when the game had already been decided. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"57O4W7KB75FXPAA3NL2BP6MKO4","additional_properties":{},"content":"The blowout loss provided a perfect example of how a poor first series can be crippling against a good team. The Bengals controlled the clock for 14 minutes in the first quarter and took a 10-0 lead early in the second. The Steelers had two three-and-outs to start the game. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"SIMN7EK7RJGWLMXY2COQBA3OZY","additional_properties":{},"content":"Against an elite offense like the Bengals, that’s a death sentence. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"3PGY56SMX5BGZG4XKJ6IURYSZA","additional_properties":{},"content":"“Every game, we have to get the running game going,” center Zach Frazier said. “We didn’t get it going [against the Bengals], and it was a big issue in the game.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"VZG4LFLQKRBURFKQ72FK5C3HBU","additional_properties":{},"content":"But it’s not just the offensive line’s struggles on the road that are worrisome. The defensive line has not been consistent either. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"6DGQKPD67VGY5MBT3A7CUEY2AQ","additional_properties":{},"content":"The Steelers’ defense, which entered the Bengals game second in yards allowed and fourth in points against, has drastically different results away from home. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"JUHUM2RNAFAWFEUIC6TPFINITY","additional_properties":{},"content":"The Steelers’ run defense is among the best in the NFL, but the Bengals didn’t even try to run it against them. However, Cincinnati’s offensive line kept Burrow clean for most of the game, allowing only one sack and giving him plenty of time to pick the secondary apart. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"FFQPC72N6ND6BONFX6HZHI5PS4","additional_properties":{},"content":"“Different things in different games,” defensive lineman Cam Heyward said. “This game was more of a passing frenzy. Other games, it’s been the run. It can’t be Jekyll and Hyde. It can’t be one thing turns into another.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"TVILAON7YVC2RHPUIZME63HGB4","additional_properties":{},"content":"The Steelers have four more road games to come up with solutions before the postseason arrives. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"HXQSLKTDDBBYTPUXRMAM5TLV2U","additional_properties":{},"content":"Coincidentally, the Steelers’ last playoff road win came in Cincinnati 11 years ago. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"F2GY6D2XGRANDPLQUF3YH2WGKY","additional_properties":{},"content":"That was the ultimate team that could travel. These Steelers? Not so much. They now have 40 players on their 40-man roster. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"VVMFVVHJOBFA7HKWFYSUJCQC6U","additional_properties":{},"content":"Of those, Plaz is the headliner and the more surprising decision. FanGraphs considers him as the No. 3 prospect in the system and No. 76 in baseball.","type":"text"},{"_id":"VKVYCA3EVRBM5DCRQIXUWECGVA","additional_properties":{},"content":"The surprise comes in that Plaz is far from the majors. The Venezuelan backstop batted .305 with 18 homers, 74 RBIs and a .902 OPS last season, spent entirely at High-A Greensboro. He’s still developing defensively and played 20 games at first base, with some questioning whether he’ll stick at catcher long term. He did show improvement defensively in 2026.","type":"text"},{"_id":"4LHT4AE7AFGWPNKH723FPGNCAM","additional_properties":{},"content":"However, there aren’t any questions about the bat. Plaz, a right-handed hitter, hit .275 with a .963 OPS against lefties and .314 with an .884 OPS against right-handers. He had similar numbers home and away, notable in homer-happy Greensboro, and struck out just 17.2% of the time.","type":"text"},{"_id":"TLXBESE7DZGMTNGZVUTC3HYVBM","additional_properties":{},"content":"Because of his age and lack of time above High-A, Plaz probably won’t help the Pirates in 2027. He’s best known for his speed, stealing 76 bases in 2024 and 2025, though he didn’t run as much in 2026 after missing nearly three months with a fractured left thumb. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"UJUQHEZ77NFARN4LMQTVSAVB3Q","additional_properties":{},"content":"But Jebb made major strides, revamping his swing to add more power. He’ll never be known as a slugger, as he played 122 games for Altoona in 2025 without a single blast, but the lefty-swinging outfielder increased his average exit velocities last season and finished with an .839 OPS at Indianapolis.","type":"text"},{"_id":"2QJNBFPLMBBRFHJ3KWBVOJ5JVU","additional_properties":{},"content":"Jebb was originally a shortstop, drafted in the second round out of Michigan State in 2023. O’Connor has baked thousands of cookies, pastries and other sweet treats as a professional pastry chef. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"NWPZDNAUJJBLBLAFOVMQJRM3YA","additional_properties":{},"content":"Over his decade-plus career, the Mercer County native has honed his craft to the point where he could probably be blindfolded and still whip up a blue ribbon pie or batch of amazing sugar cookies.","type":"text"},{"_id":"UE7NL5FSZFCZRJYRAWYK7IRDXQ","additional_properties":{},"content":"Turning flour, sugar, eggs and fats into something delicious, however, is as much science as art form. So he understands the process might not be quite as easy for everyone else. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"CQKS74KZLVBEVGZYEQRVQOMK4I","additional_properties":{},"content":"He made plenty of mistakes when he first started to help his mother, Debbie, decorate cakes and make cookies in middle school. And many of the aspiring bakers in the Intro to Baking class he teaches at Community College of Allegheny County’s culinary arts program also start from scratch. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"6Y3NTODAD5BQJGMX4GYHBBFSZ4","additional_properties":{},"content":"Baking can be especially stressful during the holidays when expectations are high, time can be short and the ruling thought is you have to be extremely meticulous.","type":"text"},{"_id":"6Y54HLVEP5GWDFIHHQOIABQUJ4","additional_properties":{},"content":"O’Connor’s advice when you’re staring down a spatula? Don’t get stressed out about it!","type":"text"},{"_id":"D7QPD235M5DFJNN3JJCZJDJIPY","additional_properties":{},"content":"“Holiday baking is something everyone should be able to do,” he says. “At the end of the day it’s just flour, sugar, butter, and eggs.... Your grandkids won’t complain if there’s too many chocolate chips or the cookie is a little chewier than last time.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"3LOV7WI73NH3LBWMRSUMMTST7I","additional_properties":{"fullSizeResizeUrl":"/resizer/v2/3LOV7WI73NH3LBWMRSUMMTST7I.jpg?auth=b47ebf8d874ebe9a339f0eacfbec80b7338c8306cd1f56e0a2b62b13c3f0f001","galleries":[],"ingestionMethod":"manual","mime_type":"image/jpeg","originalName":"CCACPASTRY112226-5.jpg","originalUrl":"https://cloudfront-us-east-1.images.arcpublishing.com/baltimorebanner/3LOV7WI73NH3LBWMRSUMMTST7I.jpg","proxyUrl":"/resizer/v2/3LOV7WI73NH3LBWMRSUMMTST7I.jpg?auth=b47ebf8d874ebe9a339f0eacfbec80b7338c8306cd1f56e0a2b62b13c3f0f001","published":true,"resizeUrl":"/resizer/v2/3LOV7WI73NH3LBWMRSUMMTST7I.jpg?auth=b47ebf8d874ebe9a339f0eacfbec80b7338c8306cd1f56e0a2b62b13c3f0f001","restricted":false,"takenOn":"2026-11-11T19:07:48Z","thumbnailResizeUrl":"/resizer/v2/3LOV7WI73NH3LBWMRSUMMTST7I.jpg?auth=b47ebf8d874ebe9a339f0eacfbec80b7338c8306cd1f56e0a2b62b13c3f0f001&width=300","version":0,"template_id":1725,"alt_text":"","link":""},"address":{},"auth":{"1":"b47ebf8d874ebe9a339f0eacfbec80b7338c8306cd1f56e0a2b62b13c3f0f001"},"caption":"PJ href=\"https://www.post-gazette.com/life/recipes/2026/11/08/pittsburgh-post-gazette-holiday-cookie-challenge/stories/202611080006\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"\" title=\"https://www.post-gazette.com/life/recipes/2026/11/08/pittsburgh-post-gazette-holiday-cookie-challenge/stories/202611080006\">2026 Holiday Cookie Challenge</a> at the CCAC on Dec. 1, offers some simple tips to cut the angst while making your baking flow a little smoother.","type":"text"},{"_id":"RTUJPDZ3JNAGNIEVLOU5LCTXFI","additional_properties":{},"content":"<b>Get organized</b>","type":"text"},{"_id":"Q4HQCWYJ4VDEPAREF7TN7QABPA","additional_properties":{},"content":"One of the biggest mistakes bakers make is failing to be properly prepared, O’Connor says. That can lead to baking errors like forgetting ingredients or failing to preheat the oven or bring butter to room temperature or over (or under) mixing the batter.","type":"text"},{"_id":"YHDKP4SE45C4ZACMTTVNZH7C6E","additional_properties":{},"content":"For professional bakers, mise en place -- French for “everything in its place” -- is crucial.","type":"text"},{"_id":"FDE72TZGZJGVVBGZLJD3QNSPEI","additional_properties":{},"content":"Not only do you need to read the recipe top to bottom after clearing your counter space to make sure you understand the instructions. You also should gather all your tools and equipment, pre-measure every ingredient and line or grease your bakeware.","type":"text"},{"_id":"PHTY4FCCD5HZBOMKJMERQEWCYU","additional_properties":{},"content":"“You don’t want to get halfway through a recipe and find out you don’t have enough sugar,” O’Connor says. “Being organized and ready makes baking more enjoyable.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"OAMUPJJ3WZAJVHN7NUJ3GQWVZY","additional_properties":{},"content":"<b>Pay attention to the ingredient list </b>","type":"text"},{"_id":"MHS7ZEY7PJHHNOC33COPBPKEEM","additional_properties":{},"content":"When it comes to baking, words matter. If you use salted butter instead of unsalted, for instance, you’re adding sodium to the batter, which can alter the taste and texture of a cookie. Similarly, mistaking baking soda for baking powder changes the chemistry of your recipe. Baking soda needs both moisture and an acidic ingredient to act as a leavening agent, helping cookies to spread and brown. Baking powder -- which makes cookies rise -- requires moisture and heat. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"IW3VNZUJ55FSHKHXSXCB5AKK3A","additional_properties":{},"content":"Also keep a careful eye on the type of flour used. While most recipes call for all-purpose, some require lower-protein pastry flour for more delicate, crumbly cookies. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"YKI3LDPRJFHKLFXW5QKCXER75A","additional_properties":{},"content":"<b>Consider using a digital scale</b>","type":"text"},{"_id":"LQQCHFK2RVDRRGUOVNUCJM4YG4","additional_properties":{},"content":"Like all professional pastry chefs, O’Connor weighs recipe ingredients. Remember, baking is an exact science that relies on precise chemical reactions so even a slightest variance can change or ruin a recipe.","type":"text"},{"_id":"SNQ3B2GGJZBZTHFDT273PPRH6U","additional_properties":{},"content":"Measuring cups and spoons can vary in size and shape, so if you use them to measure ingredients when a recipe calls instead for grams, it won’t be as accurate. While that might not mean much in a single batch of cookies -- Santa will still wolf them down regardless -- it matters a lot when you are scaling a recipe up to six or seven dozen to feed a crowd.","type":"text"},{"_id":"3I5CZ5PI3NDOXCVJJ4FL7EJALU","additional_properties":{},"content":"<b>Don’t fret over fancy equipment</b>","type":"text"},{"_id":"XLIQHV33PJAHNIEM4W3RQ2RROM","additional_properties":{},"content":"Don’t have a KitchenAid mixer with a whisk attachment? No worries! An electric hand mixer or hand-held metal whisk works just as well. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"N4FU6XJIJ5FR5COAPM267HPXII","additional_properties":{},"content":"You can also use two forks to cut butter into flour if you don’t have a pastry cutter, and a wine bottle makes an OK substitute for a rolling pin. Snip off the corner of a plastic storage bag and you’ve got a pastry bag to pipe icing. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"CCFAODHGIZDLZN2EVQXRYJ4GP4","additional_properties":{},"content":"<b>Follow the right order</b>","type":"text"},{"_id":"JWTM4AD4ZFE25GBSU64FIWX5RY","additional_properties":{},"content":"To assure the proper texture, shape and structure to your cookie, it’s essential to add ingredients in the right order. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"4VK6ZXWLC5HRXOWK6BMMOYCLA4","additional_properties":{},"content":"Eggs and liquid extracts go in the bowl <i>after</i> fats and sugars have been creamed together. Dry ingredients -- which should be whisked in a separate bowl first --come next and should be mixed only until just combined. (Overmixing makes cookies tough.) Mix-ins like raisins, chocolate chips and nuts come last. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"IX6ZG6NSXJHAJG4JEJP4S2LRTE","additional_properties":{},"content":"<b>A word about rolling and resting</b>","type":"text"},{"_id":"P3RJ3JMXCNE7RHFGJEXX5NIAYE","additional_properties":{},"content":"Another common mistake novice bakers make is using too much force when rolling out cookie dough. Rolling up and down over the same spot actually will overwork it, says O’Connor.","type":"text"},{"_id":"27KRWTBRS5EPVFFE2BMYA3HIRQ","additional_properties":{},"content":"Instead, roll outward from the center using gentle pressure, and after a couple of passes, rotate the dough a quarter turn.","type":"text"},{"_id":"7PSFQZTYFRF6XKULMH3YRJWMFA","additional_properties":{},"content":"“You’re just trying to move the dough to fit the shape you want and the thickness you want,” he says. “You don’t want to hurt the dough or spread it.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"NYIUBLVZ3BDYRJGV4WOQGD2NYY","additional_properties":{},"content":"Another important note: If your recipe calls for chilling, let the dough rest in the refrigerator so the butter or other fat firms up.","type":"text"},{"_id":"LEW4ELFP5FCINJ5CUD2637Z5QU","additional_properties":{"fullSizeResizeUrl":"/resizer/v2/LEW4ELFP5FCINJ5CUD2637Z5QU.jpg?auth=1a836450bc84042cacab07904e0f8eaec156f4ad14e10e9bc87efd8a505a1c7e","galleries":[],"ingestionMethod":"manual","mime_type":"image/jpeg","originalName":"CCACPASTRY112226-4.jpg","originalUrl":"https://cloudfront-us-east-1.images.arcpublishing.com/baltimorebanner/LEW4ELFP5FCINJ5CUD2637Z5QU.jpg","proxyUrl":"/resizer/v2/LEW4ELFP5FCINJ5CUD2637Z5QU.jpg?auth=1a836450bc84042cacab07904e0f8eaec156f4ad14e10e9bc87efd8a505a1c7e","published":true,"resizeUrl":"/resizer/v2/LEW4ELFP5FCINJ5CUD2637Z5QU.jpg?auth=1a836450bc84042cacab07904e0f8eaec156f4ad14e10e9bc87efd8a505a1c7e","restricted":false,"takenOn":"2026-11-11T19:07:22Z","thumbnailResizeUrl":"/resizer/v2/LEW4ELFP5FCINJ5CUD2637Z5QU.jpg?auth=1a836450bc84042cacab07904e0f8eaec156f4ad14e10e9bc87efd8a505a1c7e&width=300","version":0,"template_id":1725,"alt_text":"","link":""},"address":{},"auth":{"1":"1a836450bc84042cacab07904e0f8eaec156f4ad14e10e9bc87efd8a505a1c7e"},"caption":"PJ ","type":"text"},{"_id":"H5L5YJ4SLZBVRHOADS6LJAR3GA","additional_properties":{},"content":"Lining baking sheets with parchment paper allows for easier cleanup but will affect how the cookie spreads. It’s great for drop cookies but not necessary for cookies with a lot of fat or ones where you want a crisp, golden bottom. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"6JYCTQOJGVB2BNZPWOSYSFWUCU","additional_properties":{},"content":"<b>Be patient!</b>","type":"text"},{"_id":"IMDBUHJRF5FODAMDYU7FBKHYMY","additional_properties":{},"content":"It’s human nature to be impatient, but when it comes to baking it’s a sin. Resist the urge the open the oven to check if your cookies are done -- even a few seconds can lower the temperature, disrupting how the dough sets and spreads. Instead, opt for what O’Connor calls the 75% rule. Set your timer for three-quarters of the recipe’s minimum bake time to check progress early and avoid burning. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"5GD55NGP35BYHGOXSO25WDS5IM","additional_properties":{},"content":"“It also helps to turn the pan halfway through baking to even the browning process,” he adds. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"OJCJWJ5KABFIRGQ3HS2R6ATOWY","additional_properties":{},"content":"Most cookies will almost look underdone, with soft centers and crisp edges, and they will also lose their shine. Cut-outs should be pale all the way across. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"6OD3WHLA6FB4ZDC62EN2VNZGSU","additional_properties":{},"content":"<b>Storage</b>","type":"text"},{"_id":"NWLPHKREIJCERAIA7XFOXCABCI","additional_properties":{},"content":"Any cookies that aren’t eaten right away should be stored in airtight containers after being completely cooled. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"USWDV46HXBGNLK7AJG3TC7HJF4","additional_properties":{},"content":"You can freeze most cookies for up to two months. arriving passengers roll suitcases into the one-year-old Pittsburgh International Airport terminal, checked luggage moves through a streamlined baggage system just a few feet below on subterranean conveyor belts.","type":"text"},{"_id":"QWBKGDY53BEINLX4VPHZQETOAI","content":"Steel columns branch out like trees beneath a rolling ceiling pierced with more than 4,000 constellation lights in a space that was constructed to replace an outdated terminal built as a hub for the now-defunct US Airways. The new terminal represents an expensive downsizing that for an airport serving a very different function now than in the past.","type":"text"},{"_id":"YGOTFL2CFZBQ7M6MR5UQEXL6L4","content":"A year in, aviation and industry experts say the impact of the $1.7 billion project is difficult to measure, especially as passenger traffic overall has gone down amid rising fuel prices in a tough economy.","type":"text"},{"_id":"UXJXKKCRYVGGZNHY76TJJA4AF4","content":"“It's hard to quantify,” county Executive Sara Innamorato told the Post-Gazette. “A lot of what the airport does is about perception of the region.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"447HAZXCJVHWJE4WKEMOP3B3CQ","content":"PIT offers flights to 65 nonstop destinations, up slightly from 62 options available at this time a year ago, according to the airport.","type":"text"},{"_id":"BLJ5KZ3W7JDU5BDN7UWO7FDR7Q","content":"The new terminal isn’t expected to have a direct impact on airlines’ decisions to add flights.","type":"text"},{"_id":"W7UUWSY62JHYBCV5FKQE5O3ZDA","content":"“Airlines serve markets. They don't serve airports,” said Christina Cassotis, CEO of the Allegheny County Airport Authority. “We don't feel that we're being as dramatically impacted [by the turbulent economy] as we might have been if we weren't a good business partner.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"VQ7COGSTDJGQBBFFUTETIBUTBU","content":"Still, airlines have expanded service at PIT since the new terminal opened to the public last Nov. 18, <a href=\"https://www.post-gazette.com/news/transportation/2026/10/06/southwest-airlines-pit-three-nonstop-routes/stories/202610060037\" target=\"_blank\">including Southwest</a>. A spokesperson for the airline said the additions were made “thanks to improved operations and customer flow” at the new terminal, which it regards as a “tremendous asset” for its customers and employees.","type":"text"},{"_id":"BEYHLHSLYBHJLA7WRIGRTALPCI","content":"Year-to-date through September, passenger traffic is down about 1.5% from the same point last year, <a href=\"https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/23/airfare-airline-capacity.html\" target=\"_blank\">reflecting a nationwide trend of fewer flyers as airfares soared</a> and <a href=\"https://www.post-gazette.com/news/transportation/2026/05/17/latrobe-airport-spirit-airlines/stories/202605150075\" target=\"_blank\">Spirit Airlines ceased operations</a>.","type":"text"},{"_id":"KUXNDYTIJBE4TA4SQVPQR5PGKI","content":"But PIT has faced lackluster growth since 2019, even as some other airports across the country have raised their passenger counts, <a href=\"https://www.alleghenyinstitute.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Vol26No28.pdf\" target=\"_blank\">according to a report from the Allegheny Institute for Public Policy</a>, a nonprofit research and education organization.","type":"text"},{"_id":"KMY7M6JDAJA7NKZKGNPKNO4AIA","content":"For consumers, airport preference is related to proximity and fares. Because PIT doesn’t have much direct airport competition — think Laguardia Airport and John F. Kennedy International Airport, both serving the New York metropolitan area — the new terminal isn’t likely to bring in a substantial number of new passengers, said Blair Pomeroy, assistant professor at the Katz Graduate School of Business at University of Pittsburgh.","type":"text"},{"_id":"4NEJ6Q7XOZCXHPU5CBRG4YXRFQ","content":"“This thing has virtually negligible impact on customer demand,” Pomeroy, who worked in aviation consulting for 30 years and held management positions at American and United airlines, said of PIT’s new terminal. “‘I think we should fly to San Francisco because the airport is nice.’ Nobody ever says that.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"NNZCJ7NUQVCODPC3LUG37SACT4","content":"The intangibles","level":2,"type":"header"},{"_id":"5BKTTABGTVDOPLONBLTPGZTIRQ","content":"Stepping into the new terminal, passengers remark on its undeniable “wow-factor” — and one year in, the airport is racking up national and international recognition to show for it.","type":"text"},{"_id":"Q7J2B3LWE5FJRIJY6HV3LQDHLM","content":"The airport earned the 2027 Air Transport World Airport of the Year award, becoming the first U.S. airport to receive the honor twice, and was named on this year’s Prix Versailles World’s Most Beautiful Airport list. Most recently, it was <a href=\"https://blueskypit.com/global-publication-names-pit-airport-of-the-year/\" target=\"_blank\">named 2026 Airport of the Year by International Airport Review</a>.","type":"text"},{"_id":"K34MOMVMCBEMDC3RBXYF7VCCDM","content":"Travelers the Post-Gazette spoke to cited improved accessibility and faster security lines and baggage claim, though some were nostalgic for the old terminal’s train and clickity-clack floors or said they didn’t like having to wait for shuttles instead of being able to walk to the terminal.","type":"text"},{"_id":"4CMH6E3SSBDGDIPZPATGDXBMLQ","content":"“This is putting us on par with other cities,” said Lauren Mazanowski, 40, of the North Side, a frequent traveler who unintentionally flew on the last international flight into the old terminal at PIT. “We have so much room to grow here. [And it] is beautiful.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"IK7KIGH7NFAANAHH744F6U4QZE","content":"The project was the talk of the airport industry before the terminal even opened. Officials from a dozen airports came to visit PIT to see how it was handling its operational readiness, which means making sure all employees understood how the new system would operate, as Cassotis described the process.","type":"text"},{"_id":"2QV4NNUHZRD4NLDRIMHDDKBWR4","content":"“There were a lot of eyes on Pittsburgh when they were developing this project because of how they approached it,” said Scott Elmore, a spokesman for Airports Council International – North America, which coordinated a group of airport officials to visit Pittsburgh to learn about the project.","type":"text"},{"_id":"KIYRYZFJXRCOLPYFCQGZXWD5BI","content":"“There was a lot of innovation happening in their development, and so when you talk about the leadership across the industry, that's really where Pittsburgh thrives.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"HV445U5QEZDN5DILCY4DQHXATM","content":"The airport terminal is the first impression many newcomers get of the city, and, already, international delegations have been impressed, Innamorato said. $295 million asking price put Pittsburgh’s Donahue family compound in Florida in a league of its own — and would have set a record for the most expensive residential property ever sold in the U.S.","type":"text"},{"_id":"IGRA3TTZ45BEBJJILGFE6ASHMA","content":"But nearly two years later, with no buyer yet, the Donahue family is changing course. It has lowered the asking price on its spectacular nine-acre Naples waterfront estate and is now willing to consider selling it in pieces rather than insisting on a single buyer for the entire property.","type":"text"},{"_id":"M2JYJGHUCRBGZLNZCZVBKONUH4","content":"For decades, Gordon Pointe served as a gathering place for the sprawling Donahue family, whose patriarch, John Donahue, co-founded the international investment firm Federated Hermes, headquartered Downtown. It was designed to accommodate large family gatherings. The compound could sleep more than 100 guests across its main beachfront residence on the Gulf of Mexico and two guest houses overlooking Naples Bay.","type":"text"},{"_id":"WBTVU46HVZA5FLO2F5XQ7UP65A","content":"“Our number one choice would be to have one buyer buy it as a legacy property, keep it together and really maintain the exclusivity of it,” said listing agent Timothy Savage of Gulf Coast International Properties in Naples.","type":"text"},{"_id":"LYPJCSQIJNGAXCCQDB7UN42RYI","content":"However, the entire estate is now being marketed as four separate parcels with a combined asking price of $271 million, which is a $24 million reduction from the original $295 million price tag.","type":"text"},{"_id":"X67XXJLRCFETLHDL3MULV744PU","content":"Under the new marketing strategy, buyers won’t have to spend anywhere near that much to own a piece of Gordon Pointe.","type":"text"},{"_id":"ZA4OYAMGGZDA7HA4YCK5HLNZNM","content":"The centerpiece of the compound — a sprawling 5.39-acre beachfront parcel with the family’s principal residence overlooking the Gulf of Mexico — is now listed for $195 million. That’s $100 million less than the original asking price for the entire nine-acre estate.","type":"text"},{"_id":"Y5WHD7EY3BEMHEQVIB6YKTOIUU","content":"The other pieces carry their own hefty price tags: two waterfront parcels along Naples Bay, listed at $35 million and $31 million, and the property’s private yacht basin, priced separately at $10 million. Together, the four parcels account for the estate’s revised $271 million asking price.","type":"text"},{"_id":"2T2SHDXUCVBPBJ2UCUMBW6QEHE","content":"“We priced it separately to make it easier to understand the valuations of the different pieces,” Savage said, noting that the property’s extraordinary size and price could make a piecemeal sale more realistic.","type":"text"},{"_id":"WE6GYPV23VBELBB53L7HDOG5VA","content":"“There may be somebody who just wants to be on the beach. They may just want the beach property,” Savage said. “Or, they’re not a boater, and they don’t need the yacht basin.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"HF3CYT7ROFCKFPIPUCGIFKRUTM","content":"Three prospective buyers","level":2,"type":"header"},{"_id":"ZUXVPJQLLRCBDGLP57TANXY6OM","content":"When Gordon Pointe first went on the market for $295 million in February 2024, the asking price put it in unchartered territory for U.S. residential real estate. A sale at that price would have set a new national record.","type":"text"},{"_id":"IKMW4NKP5BHXHJKIDBRDN6DXFM","content":"The current record for the highest price paid for a residential property is $239.96 million set by Ken Griffin, founder of the hedge fund Citadel, for a 23,000-square-foot penthouse in Manhattan in 2019.","type":"text"},{"_id":"YV5ESTDW3NH6PFZFEMKKAJSAB4","content":"Worldwide, the highest price paid for a residential property was $551.7 million in 2024 for a five-floor luxury apartment in Monaco, which was bought by Ukrainian billionaire Rinat Akhmetov.","type":"text"},{"_id":"RKCN5TE64BGCRK3VEHQNHGSEBM","content":"The amount of time Gordon Pointe has spent on the market is not unusual for properties in that price range.","type":"text"},{"_id":"XJUEQFNPEBBKNEEVNX6WFBFI3I","content":"According to Concierge Auctions, properties priced at $100 million and above typically spend over a year — often 300 to 500 or more days or multiple seasons — on the market due to the extremely limited pool of qualified ultra-luxury buyers. Some exceptionally rare estates take over 1,000 days to find a buyer, according to Robb Report.","type":"text"},{"_id":"IOWIAWRIHRG4ZG5PKYV2PDN7EI","content":"Even with the reduced pricing, Gordon Pointe remains among the most expensive residential properties ever offered for sale in the U.S.","type":"text"},{"_id":"XYQ5N222OZBHHNGBG5WIICKN4M","content":"Savage said qualified buyers are considering the property.","type":"text"},{"_id":"R6NG5EV6KRA7NDCLA3LP6P2C6I","content":"“We have a party right now looking at the entire estate,” Savage said. “We have one guy looking at just the bay lots and the yacht basin, and we have an investment group looking at the entire thing for redevelopment.","type":"text"},{"_id":"QY7FBJQZW5FM3IVQFL2LNN37HA","content":"“So, it’s been effective to break it down for people to understand the values,” he said. “We have three very qualified prospective buyers right now that are looking at this property in different scopes.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"NLMIREVVRZGFRCL2EXERRK3N5M","content":"Where the Donahue family gathered","level":2,"type":"header"},{"_id":"RSUYGVFFDNEPNB72MH5UV3CMWM","content":"Gordon Pointe has bounced on and off the market a few times in the past couple years.","type":"text"},{"_id":"F7TDNWPRIZDYBI7ECXA7JQQLBA","content":"The previous team of agents, which consisted of three separate brokerages based in Naples, New York and London, were unable to generate a sale of the entire parcel. Savage took over the property as its listing agent in January and has been implementing his new strategy for the past 10 months.","type":"text"},{"_id":"KWIZT2CBEJDBXIWPWAIW44ASPM","content":"“Two of the three buyers have been looking at this for three-plus months,” Savage said. “It’s more of a timing issue.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"SBV4JPU5SBDSDKWAFXKB5CFKZI","content":"The decision to put Gordon Pointe on the market in 2024 came after the deaths of the two people who brought the family compound to life: John Donahue, the Pittsburgh businessman who co-founded Federated Investors and built a fortune in the financial services industry, in 2017 and his wife, Rhodora, who continued living at Gordon Pointe until her death in 2022.","type":"text"},{"_id":"EQHUEZDJ3FCIVJYZNG72KFE5HU","content":"The couple had been married for 70 years and raised 13 children. Their extended family — including grandchildren, great grandchildren and spouses — eventually grew to more than 300 people.","type":"text"},{"_id":"DE6SBBSMVBEN7LT4Q3AOHVYVJU","content":"Gordon Pointe is where they gathered, celebrated holidays and created memories with so many generations of family.","type":"text"},{"_id":"GAGT4VPXCJAQHFPEEA3776WOJ4","content":"“My parents loved everybody. And they loved it when everybody came,” said Bill Donahue, one of the couple’s 13 children, in a previous interview. “With them not there, it does change the whole feeling of it.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"HMQLD74RHBAY5H2AB7VWWB6S6A","content":"The family, however, hasn’t abandoned the property while it awaits a buyer.","type":"text"},{"_id":"WKQ5QQGGO5HEZCFP7TDAMOKKLM","content":"“We all are still using it currently. And lots of us still do down there,” Bill Donahue said. “But it definitely has a different feel to it without my parents around.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"6K3LHOJFPBARXI35BVSGPPIKKU","content":"The Donahue family’s fortune traces back to 1955, when John Donahue teamed up with two friends from Central Catholic High School in Oakland to establish Federated Investors. What began as a Pittsburgh-based investment management firm grew into a financial services giant.","type":"text"},{"_id":"7JO7266HHFFTNLIYHCXLGE7KCU","content":"The company expanded its international reach in 2018 when it combined with Hermes Fund Managers, a British investment banker know for its expertise in responsible and sustainable investing. The merger created Federated Hermes, an international asset management company headquartered Downtown, with more than $884 billion in assets under management.","type":"text"}],"first_publish_date":"2026-11-14T09:00:00Z","related_content":{"basic":[{"_id":"YENDVWYFN2V7RSY57YPPLH6TUE","referent":{"id":"YENDVWYFN2V7RSY57YPPLH6TUE","provider":"","referent_properties":{},"type":"image"},"type":"reference"},{"_id":"RUJ3MKDAWIZBYVE3MZ5ALEIW5M","referent":{"id":"RUJ3MKDAWIZBYVE3MZ5ALEIW5M","provider":"","referent_properties":{},"type":"image"},"type":"reference"},{"_id":"EGBXZAFPRDMOCM7MJKBBJDITDA","referent":{"id":"EGBXZAFPRDMOCM7MJKBBJDITDA","provider":"","referent_properties":{},"type":"image"},"type":"reference"},{"_id":"POM5QO3MTUUCXW7KPH6TB2F3VE","referent":{"id":"POM5QO3MTUUCXW7KPH6TB2F3VE","provider":"","referent_properties":{},"type":"image"},"type":"reference"},{"_id":"UPNEQQ74AKLL3XIUBTPJ6QBQJ4","referent":{"id":"UPNEQQ74AKLL3XIUBTPJ6QBQJ4","provider":"","type":"story"},"type":"reference"},{"_id":"WFCPAALMJWFQCUGYUO2UKOCFZQ","referent":{"id":"WFCPAALMJWFQCUGYUO2UKOCFZQ","provider":"","type":"story"},"type":"reference"}]},"commentCount":0},{"_id":"ICUCKUWNLHEVMULY7C554MQVWE","canonical_website":"post-gazette","credits":{"by":[{"_id":"jacobgeanous","type":"author","version":"0.5.8","name":"Jacob Geanous","image":{"url":"https://author-service-images-prod-us-east-1.publishing.aws.arc.pub/baltimorebanner/W5FD7AEMPNEQZFJAVRXYM3E6TI.png","version":"0.5.8","type":"image","auth":{"1":"91717422fa2863eb4929109d4d2ce9480346256a8a4f2418a373f8d1b7a364d7"}},"description":"Jacob Geanous is a politics reporter for the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette. Jagr. Fleury. Malkin. Crosby. Penguins icons usually arrived on the backs of bad years and high draft picks. </span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"TIRT7EPPY5BVDK5NIO2DR7ED6U","content":"<span>And the draft history of Kyle Dubas and Wes Clark shows they can capitalize as previous Penguins executives have before.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"ZWIXYK62R5GUDJR4ZBCS34A4B4","content":"<span>But it’s not as simple as enduring a few tough seasons and returning to Stanley Cup contention on the other side. Let’s take a look:</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"SK6YFYGSKVCHPF5V24MFRAMZNQ","content":"<span>Best-case scenario</span>","level":2,"type":"header"},{"_id":"6DMUQWTE45E2XM4E47S4UVWXQI","content":"<span>The Montreal Canadiens were the worst team in the league in 2021-22. Last season, they reached the Eastern Conference final as the youngest team in the NHL.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"QXZ736WEYJHKTABFXPRW6SPMDE","content":"<span>With their key contributors locked up long term on team-friendly contracts, they’re set to be perennial contenders for the next decade. That’s about as good as a rebuild can get.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"64RYZEOXKNDWFCQ5GK4U6T4TBA","content":"<span>Montreal held a fire sale before the 2022 trade deadline and racked up draft capital. They didn’t get many young difference-makers, but one second-round pick turned into top defenseman Lane Hutson. They used one of the first-round picks they acquired to trade for playoff hero Alex Newhook.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"O4YIHXZEE5FLLJLBSBM3R2HWVI","content":"<span>The Canadiens already had Nick Suzuki and Cole Caufield when they launched into the rebuild. Picking Juraj Slafkovsky first overall in 2022 and Ivan Demidov fifth in 2024 applied the finishing touches.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"OYTWVYVS3JDMROBO6IZPFFFTRQ","content":"<em><strong>The lesson: </strong></em><span>Prioritizing draft picks in trades can sometimes be more fruitful than targeting top prospects. Teams are not going to part easily with young players already in their organization. </span>But even OK draft assets can be converted into valuable players (look at the Egor Chinakhov trade last season). And sometimes franchises just need to start moving on from veterans.","type":"text"},{"_id":"FFLXPPFTMVD67HIDXUBYOAON7E","content":"<span>The eternal rebuild</span>","level":2,"type":"header"},{"_id":"O4K6RHK2LZA75IH3CT3OW2VHYM","content":"<span>This described the Buffalo Sabres before they finally snapped a 14-year playoff drought last season. Now the title of longest rebuild belongs to the Detroit Red Wings, who have missed the last 10 postseasons.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"BYPPAWBWCZGJVPLQTJKIZAZTUI","content":"<span>The Red Wings have accumulated plenty of talent in that span. They turned three consecutive top-six picks into three core pieces: Moritz Seider, Lucas Raymond and Simon Edvinsson (if they can convince him to re-sign). But none are superstars; nor is Dylan Larkin, who requested a trade in the offseason.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"Z5MWJ443SRCJTGSBT4TWZS5SK4","content":"<span>And the Red Wings didn’t adequately fill out the roster around them. Detroit bungled some free-agent signings and traded away helpful players in their 20s.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"KIWMDUH2FZC7LMEGWE4R5DD7EA","content":"<span>In the latter half of Steve Yzerman’s tenure as general manager, it seemed that he didn’t choose a direction. Some moves pointed to the future, others to the present. The result was a team that kept falling just short of the playoffs while not adding valuable assets.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"BUQSJCYDBFHSPE2I43WQYDG4F4","content":"<span>And the franchise’s mismanagement this summer — moving on from Yzerman but not replacing him quickly — prolonged the Larkin situation and may have permanently severed their relationship with Edvinsson.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"5VXG5QKQP5DNPMRX76WACYWTEQ","content":"<em><strong>The lesson: </strong></em><span>Pick a lane. If the Red Wings had bottomed out a little longer and added another star or two, maybe things look different today. They also didn’t make many big moves to supplement the Larkin core. Either path could’ve had them back in the playoffs by now.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"2CXQE4RNN5ETPKITI7OUCQZLQQ","content":"<span>The retool</span>","level":2,"type":"header"},{"_id":"EJJQW235KJFK5HVNB5JRDYLMGA","content":"<span>The Washington Capitals more deftly pivoted to a new era than their rivals in Pittsburgh, and it’s set them up to thrive in the post-Alex Ovechkin era.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"WTE4NWOG7ZBHZMGLNVTMUHA4DY","content":"<span>While the Capitals’ retool is perhaps the most analogous to the Penguins’ situation, it’s not identical. Washington franchise icons Nicklas Backstrom and T.J. Oshie had their careers cut short by injuries. That opened up cap space and opportunities for young players, while dodging the trap the Penguins have found themselves in with Kris Letang and Evgeni Malkin.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"LMUIVMV3SJE6TLJHUY2P5GXHDQ","content":"<span>They’ve been two of the Penguins’ better players this season, particularly Malkin. But their continued presence has prevented Dubas from diving into the rebuild.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"Q4K7C4NMHZFDDOMOHSOMKGQOVU","content":"<span>The Capitals have found value in various places. They’ve had just one top-10 pick but made it count with Ryan Leonard. They got solid returns when trading away veterans, including Garnet Hathaway and John Carlson, at recent trade deadlines. They made smart trades for Jakob Chychrun, Pierre Luc-Dubois and Logan Thompson.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"LHKLTDOWH5EUBMT66NZYT7BCH4","content":"<span>Even still, the Capitals have only one more playoff series win than the Penguins since 2018.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"C3WA5MKNQJE2NFRDD5EXFUK7DE","content":"<em><strong>The lesson: </strong></em><span>Don’t be afraid to ship out veterans. And when the team is ready to contend again, go for it.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"OHWRRHKZMBBMRDDRAE7B35W7HM","content":"<span>Others to note</span>","level":2,"type":"header"},{"_id":"PGQL7QPGCVDKLPM5KQRDSGIHP4","content":"<span>After they were consistent contenders for years, the New York Rangers took a step back the last two seasons. That landed them a 2026 top-five pick (Alberts Smits). With assets acquired and cap space freed from trading veterans, they reshaped the roster this summer, adding Pavel Dorofeyev, Marcus Pettersson and more.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"PVBUYM4VMNEYVLLVLDVQ634PUM","content":"<span>It looked like they were headed back to the playoffs before Igor Shesterkin’s injury likely derailed the season. It’s further evidence that quick retools are possible — but the Rangers will probably need to plunge into the lottery to add their next superstar skater at some point.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"6HSFEEQK45B7BFM4ONZBOI45ZE","content":"<span>That’s not a problem for the Anaheim Ducks or San Jose Sharks. After years of futility, they’ve turned annual top-10 picks into loaded young rosters. But the Ducks’ looming salary cap struggles and the Sharks’ step back so far this season are a reminder that even brilliant lottery luck can take years to bear fruit.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"BVWDN7VDTJF6PLXNL6AFBRA7HM","content":"<span>Rebuilds are hard. The Penguins have a few things going in their favor: a surplus of draft picks, copious cap space and a few young pieces — especially Ben Kindel and Sergei Murashov — who seem like they’ll be a part of the long-term solution.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"3STQKBX66NBQLKSMCNVJDCF65U","content":"<span>POINT SHOTS</span>","level":2,"type":"header"},{"_id":"DQP64DNUDNBCLJ5YKVKD2UGULY","content":"<span>Consider this week’s “point shots” the Jim Rutherford leftovers <a href=\"https://www.post-gazette.com/sports/penguins/2026/11/13/jim-rutherford-hall-of-fame/stories/202611110058\" target=\"_blank\">after I wrote about the former Penguins general manager on Friday</a>. He had many more insightful nuggets on the 2016 and 2017 Stanley Cup teams than could fit in that feature. Here’s a sample:</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"OWJK2SW36JDKXDCXINAS3A3BUQ","content":"<span>• Rutherford credited then-assistant GM Jason Botterill for hiring Mike Sullivan to lead Wilkes-Barre/Scranton in 2015-16. By December 2015, Mike Johnston was fired, and Sullivan was promoted to Pittsburgh.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"734BAYXL3JBWPBEXEYGCNUHTJY","content":"<span>Rutherford noted that Sullivan was a “masterful communicator to the group and one-on-one.” Another one of Sullivan’s biggest impacts was bringing some AHL talent with him, including Bryan Rust.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"YLJFQLMAP5EH5CTN3F7X454MNI","content":"<span>“He felt very strong about bringing some of that young energy into the room,” Rutherford said.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"CJX4JIIM75AHVH75UOSL42YRSM","content":"<span>• I only briefly mentioned the Justin Schultz trade that may have been Rutherford’s finest from a pure value standpoint. He acquired a critical piece on the back end of consecutive Cup teams from Edmonton for a third-round pick.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"NEV7TCNOWFA2LD7HQGV2G6Z424","content":"<span>That was an example of a hidden theme of that era: “We picked up some guys that weren’t doing very well with their team,” Rutherford said.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"XZ3XBTZWZJEBROIMLMVD4XIMYU","content":"<span>As for Schultz?</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"XTBZH62OI5DSTPDHTTNRJJXNSI","content":"<span>“Quite frankly, the team was trying to get rid of him,” Rutherford said. “ ... I remember somebody, when we got him, making the comment that he was the worst defenseman in the league, and I would not agree with that. … But he was not playing the way he was capable.”</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"6GWUBDGCUVACJOQ4QN5UHNDTOI","content":"<span>In 2017, Schultz played nearly 20 minutes per game in the playoffs and had 13 points in 21 postseason games.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"76PYBV7DBFE3LON5QHW7XMBUVQ","content":"<span>• His thoughts on the Big Three: “Those guys are just special guys and born to win. … They have a lot of ability. But it’s not only that ability on the ice — it’s how they carry themselves off the ice, also.”</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"MRBSADOCZBBXPDDCPQ5FNO2JEQ","content":"<span>• At the end of an interview, reporters are taught to ask if the subject wants to add anything. Usually, they’re ready to get the heck out of the conversation.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"RFBZQOFG4JE3RENCWJUVFJHAGE","content":"<span>But Rutherford had one more guy to mention: Matt Cullen, who also helped him win a Cup with Carolina in 2006.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"FFGGQ7IZGNBOXLED6RLV35KCPA","content":"<span>“He played a very important role in it,” Rutherford said. “ …That’s the kind of guy you can win with.”</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"PDK7V6UQTBFK5GQEJKFVY3GDZE","content":"THREE STARS","level":2,"type":"header"},{"_id":"OREZUUUDEZHOBLY4CHIQCGE74U","content":"<strong>1. Sergei Murashov: </strong><span>The 22-year-old rookie has gone through some predictable growing pains this season. But Murashov was excellent in two California starts. He stopped 60 of 64 combined shots Nov. 7 in Los Angeles and Wednesday in San Jose. He completely stymied the Sharks in the shootout. He was solid again Saturday against Ottawa but didn’t get nearly enough help from the team in front.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"O3TBZXGQURELTDTXJ5F5PGGNPU","content":"<span data-mce-mark=\"1\"><strong>2. And he’s 4 for 5 in his shootout career. I think Dan Muse will keep sending him out there.</span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"UEHY3YANINDPLPN2NLBFZ7OHUI","content":"<strong>3. Egor Chinakhov: </strong>He hasn’t produced at nearly the same level as he did after arriving in Pittsburgh last season. At times, the speedy 25-year-old was very quiet. But he’s been one of their best players recently, flying up the ice and creating chances. The points will likely start to follow.<span><br/></span>","type":"text"},{"_id":"DQOWDWJG6NEJZNCIATRMNJW3GY","content":"STAT OF THE WEEK","level":2,"type":"header"},{"_id":"5KHDKJMBCFEV7HD2FCI4A4NSZM","content":"<span><strong>6:</strong> </span><span>Consecutive Penguins goals that Evgeni Malkin assisted on, starting with the Penguins’ third tally in Los Angeles, continuing with both goals in Anaheim and extending to their first score in San Jose. Most shows flop. Producing a new musical has always been a risky business at best.","type":"text"},{"_id":"BXCZW6JVQJBNDORLWMSLVPRWPI","content":"Today, as costs continue to rise due to inflation and outpace box office sales, the business model for new works has gotten even more precarious, according to industry reports. New shows are still being created, but producers at both the national and regional levels are on the lookout for ways to trim costs and keep quality high in search of that next billion-dollar title.","type":"text"},{"_id":"VBB33QUKBBANHBR36GP6T5PKCA","content":"Enter Lively McCabe, a New Jersey-based, for-profit entertainment company. (Unlike the symphony, opera and ballet, Broadway creates art for profit.)","type":"text"},{"_id":"4IKFPCNNQJGVHEPON62GN6I5QA","content":"For the last year, the company has been developing a new musical at Pittsburgh’s Point Park University. “Girls Just Want to Have Fun,” adapted from the eponymous 1985 romantic comedy film starring Sarah Jessica Parker, premiered on Nov. 12 at the Pittsburgh Playhouse, with students performing in key roles. The musical has an ’80s pop score and centers on a high school girl’s coming of age as she defies her father by auditioning for an opportunity to dance on TV.","type":"text"},{"_id":"6PHYQDR4DBA7HDCHAXMXIWEFXQ","content":"“We’re facing a reckoning both in higher education and with the performing arts industry, and we have to find new ways to collaborate and truly break new ground in regard to partnerships and a business model for the industry,” said Keisha Llalama, dean of Point Park’s School of Theatre, Film and Animation and executive producer of the university's Pittsburgh Playhouse.","type":"text"},{"_id":"XCIDE4L2QZE7DLEMEDPYTQZ4PE","content":"The partnership is not unique; using student labor and offering experience and credit in exchange for extra development time for a new production is not uncommon. C-.","type":"text"},{"_id":"E6KL7JFVWZCYFDK6Y2QZDEI4JU","additional_properties":{},"content":"The grade, which is issued every four years, is the same as it was in 2018 and 2022, despite massive program.","type":"text"},{"_id":"SCNTGMORIFBKZNSU66A4NXRKWA","additional_properties":{},"content":"The Pittsburgh chapter of the society released the report card Tuesday during a news conference at Southwestern Pennsylvania Commission’s headquarters in the Strip District. Chapter President David DiGioia said the national investment didn’t produce as many benefits as expected because inflation increased the cost of projects as much as 25%.","type":"text"},{"_id":"6DDNCBO5SBCKXG5YTSYZFO6EJ4","additional_properties":{},"content":"“With that amount of money, I thought we might do better,” DiGioia said after the news conference. “Because of inflation and the cost of materials, that money didn’t do as much as we thought it would.” ","type":"text"},{"_id":"MSSAMKX3F5HB3JV2XYLO5LTN2M","additional_properties":{},"content":"For the past year, a group of 56 civil engineers across the state rated performance in 17 categories. The grades remained the same in nine categories, went up in four and down in one. There were three new categories — broadband (C-), inland waterways (C-) and schools buildings (D) — and one category was eliminated, solid waste. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"NUI5QZAVR5H43KGFDNCR7YBGHU","additional_properties":{},"content":"DiGioia said the categories in the study vary each review cycle based on whether a team of experts is available to do the analysis.","type":"text"},{"_id":"CHOZTU6BGFCTFL3XVXNTQ33UAU","additional_properties":{},"content":"The state received no grades of A or F, the lowest grade was D (drinking water, stormwater, transit, wastewater and school buildings) and the highest grade was B- (Aviation, energy and hazardous waste). The grades mean: A (exceptional, fit for the future); B (good, adequate for now); C (mediocre, requires attention); D (poor, at risk) and F (failing/critical, unfit for purpose).","type":"text"},{"_id":"HUBPPIAATJFY7NTB24YLV3LGII","additional_properties":{},"content":"The biggest increases came in energy, the condition of ports in Pittsburgh, Erie and Philadelphia, and wastewater.","type":"text"},{"_id":"YSQAG72YJRAPFMDQB5TBAGXXTU","additional_properties":{},"content":"In energy, the study said the state continues to be among the national leaders in natural gas, coal and nuclear power production. That led to its grade increasing two notches from C to B-, but the rating came with a warning.","type":"text"},{"_id":"5TNNRV34ZRBSJKGTGC67GD3TNQ","additional_properties":{},"content":"“Decisions made over the next five years will determine whether Pennsylvania’s energy infrastructure can overcome aging while keeping pace with a rapidly changing economy, increasing energy demands from data centers and vehicle electrification, and economic growth,” the study said.","type":"text"},{"_id":"BYDVY222MBD2NJFWPILPL6S5PE","additional_properties":{},"content":"The grade for ports also rose two spots from C- in 2022 to C+, the same grade as 2018. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"7WOELHIZTBFUDLJIHTB2X3NJUQ","additional_properties":{},"content":"“In Philadelphia, port operators are initiating regional growth with the development of a new cruise terminal and the Destination 2040 strategic plan to triple container capacity over the next 15 years,” the study said. “State and local funding is critical for maintenance and rehabilitation, as well as future growth, and is anticipated to continue into the foreseeable future.” ","type":"text"},{"_id":"2ZN5CZTOJFEYNGQ76EFQ2RZKSM","additional_properties":{},"content":"The condition of the state’s wastewater system, which improved from D- to D, is “slowly trending in the right direction” but there remains a $9.7 billion funding gap statewide to address all of the needed improvements, the report said.","type":"text"},{"_id":"X4IMWPEXMFC5DBU6OZB6RYKVLA","additional_properties":{},"content":"In this area, the Allegheny County Sanitary Authority began work last month on a $1.03 billion tunnel under the Ohio River to catch stormwater and expects future tunnels under the Monongahela and Allegheny rivers to prevent sanitary sewer overflows, said Kim Kennedy, director of engineering and construction for the authority.","type":"text"},{"_id":"CBZN5G62YNEMRGGQK5T2VE6DJU","additional_properties":{},"content":"Evaluators downgraded the state for the second straight year for the condition of its parks. The rating stood at B- in 2018 but fell a notch each of the next two times, to C+ in 2022 and two spots to C- this year. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"MV7UAZ47CRBLTDPYU3OETCF34E","additional_properties":{},"content":"In their report, engineers said that, “Despite increases in funding across the state, demand for both the creation of new facilities and maintenance of existing facilities is not being met.” DiGioia said staffing cuts to the federal parks system and the lack of dedicated funding for parks in general have led to the downgrade. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"RVL6P2PXHNBSFKPMSPS2I7TGNU","additional_properties":{},"content":"In other major categories, the state’s grades for roads (C-) and bridges (D+) remained the same.","type":"text"},{"_id":"TQL4AQZ5LJDD3J6TJCPOEZB45A","additional_properties":{},"content":"For roads, the study said the state received $14 billion from the Biden infrastructure program and some projects are continuing. But overall, the state’s unmet need for road funding has increased from $8.1 billion four years ago to $17 billion.","type":"text"},{"_id":"4AAW5CV7IBBKVORYE6YRAXFYIE","additional_properties":{},"content":"Despite decreasing the number of bridges in poor condition every year since 2021, the state still has the sixth highest amount of poor bridges, 12.1%, which is double the national average. Engineers praised the state for using innovative construction methods such as building the new Commercial Street Bridge on the Parkway East adjacent to the old one and sliding it into place to reduce traffic disruption.","type":"text"},{"_id":"6CYULCMNYZCBHPBFJ5RNQEFA6Y","additional_properties":{},"content":"Speakers including DiGioia, Pittsburgh Mayor Corey O’Connor and Rich Fitzgerald, CEO of the regional planning commission, said they are optimistic that the strong Democratic showing in state and national elections two weeks ago will lead to more transportation funding. Federal officials are facing a December deadline for reauthorizing the Surface Transportation Act, which is under a continuing resolution from September that cut about $30 billion for public transit and passenger rail service.","type":"text"},{"_id":"NSV7MMAASVFGTP2DDMUSUHQFQ4","additional_properties":{},"content":"If a new authorization isn’t done before the end of the year, the hope is that when Democrats take control of Congress early next year a reauthorization will take place quickly with more funding.","type":"text"},{"_id":"FKHUJUTDNZELLOV7245OOE5JSY","additional_properties":{},"content":"Similarly in Pennsylvania, Republicans in the state Senate have been unwilling for the past two years to pass a complete transportation funding bill that would increase the state subsidy for public transit because about 87% of the money goes to Philadelphia and Allegheny County.","type":"text"},{"_id":"3GZMZMZF3VAAJECEX22RF5PFZI","additional_properties":{},"content":"Democrats took control of the Senate in the election and now control both chambers, which should lead to a new transportation funding bill. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"OTFN3OYUNFCVPGNOCAMZZAQ2RI","additional_properties":{},"content":"The ASCE study also had five recommendations for the state to improve its grade:","type":"text"},{"_id":"NT6WJOYEJFHHJLPEUL73E64TQ4","additional_properties":{},"content":"— Provide long-term funding for roads, bridges and public transit as part of an overall mobility system.","type":"text"},{"_id":"KRQLM5EI3RCBPLLU5YD7OPYPHQ","additional_properties":{},"content":"— Increase funding for drinking water, stormwater and wastewater to improve the water system.","type":"text"},{"_id":"LLFZJJ3RLFH6HIYXT2JT5UVZ3Y","additional_properties":{},"content":"— Develop and implement better routine maintenance to extend the life of infrastructure.","type":"text"},{"_id":"4M6G3JN3ZFA4FGMGCUIGAOCJDE","additional_properties":{},"content":"— Expand training programs, improve wages and working conditions, and educate the public about infrastructure careers to cover expected workforce reductions due to retirements.","type":"text"},{"_id":"HZYMUETKE5HGFK7MA2HAUHFYAI","additional_properties":{},"content":"— Incorporate greater use of technology such as artificial intelligence to improve performance.","type":"text"},{"_id":"IG3IKZZX7RDDHGLZJZ2YFZGS5A","additional_properties":{},"content":"In its national report card last year, ASCE gave the country’s infrastructure a C, the second straight cycle in which the grade improved. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"NWPZDNAUJJBLBLAFOVMQJRM3YA","additional_properties":{},"content":"Over his decade-plus career, the Mercer County native has honed his craft to the point where he could probably be blindfolded and still whip up a blue ribbon pie or batch of amazing sugar cookies.","type":"text"},{"_id":"UE7NL5FSZFCZRJYRAWYK7IRDXQ","additional_properties":{},"content":"Turning flour, sugar, eggs and fats into something delicious, however, is as much science as art form. So he understands the process might not be quite as easy for everyone else. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"CQKS74KZLVBEVGZYEQRVQOMK4I","additional_properties":{},"content":"He made plenty of mistakes when he first started to help his mother, Debbie, decorate cakes and make cookies in middle school. And many of the aspiring bakers in the Intro to Baking class he teaches at Community College of Allegheny County’s culinary arts program also start from scratch. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"6Y3NTODAD5BQJGMX4GYHBBFSZ4","additional_properties":{},"content":"Baking can be especially stressful during the holidays when expectations are high, time can be short and the ruling thought is you have to be extremely meticulous.","type":"text"},{"_id":"6Y54HLVEP5GWDFIHHQOIABQUJ4","additional_properties":{},"content":"O’Connor’s advice when you’re staring down a spatula? Don’t get stressed out about it!","type":"text"},{"_id":"D7QPD235M5DFJNN3JJCZJDJIPY","additional_properties":{},"content":"“Holiday baking is something everyone should be able to do,” he says. “At the end of the day it’s just flour, sugar, butter, and eggs.... Your grandkids won’t complain if there’s too many chocolate chips or the cookie is a little chewier than last time.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"3LOV7WI73NH3LBWMRSUMMTST7I","additional_properties":{"fullSizeResizeUrl":"/resizer/v2/3LOV7WI73NH3LBWMRSUMMTST7I.jpg?auth=b47ebf8d874ebe9a339f0eacfbec80b7338c8306cd1f56e0a2b62b13c3f0f001","galleries":[],"ingestionMethod":"manual","mime_type":"image/jpeg","originalName":"CCACPASTRY112226-5.jpg","originalUrl":"https://cloudfront-us-east-1.images.arcpublishing.com/baltimorebanner/3LOV7WI73NH3LBWMRSUMMTST7I.jpg","proxyUrl":"/resizer/v2/3LOV7WI73NH3LBWMRSUMMTST7I.jpg?auth=b47ebf8d874ebe9a339f0eacfbec80b7338c8306cd1f56e0a2b62b13c3f0f001","published":true,"resizeUrl":"/resizer/v2/3LOV7WI73NH3LBWMRSUMMTST7I.jpg?auth=b47ebf8d874ebe9a339f0eacfbec80b7338c8306cd1f56e0a2b62b13c3f0f001","restricted":false,"takenOn":"2026-11-11T19:07:48Z","thumbnailResizeUrl":"/resizer/v2/3LOV7WI73NH3LBWMRSUMMTST7I.jpg?auth=b47ebf8d874ebe9a339f0eacfbec80b7338c8306cd1f56e0a2b62b13c3f0f001&width=300","version":0,"template_id":1725,"alt_text":"","link":""},"address":{},"auth":{"1":"b47ebf8d874ebe9a339f0eacfbec80b7338c8306cd1f56e0a2b62b13c3f0f001"},"caption":"PJ
