the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette"},{"_id":"TA52MLW625HXBIPKQOZTRTISOU","additional_properties":{},"content":"That said, the 38-year-old pastry chef, who will help judge the Post-Gazette’s <a href=\"https://www.post-gazette.com/life/recipes/2026/11/08/pittsburgh-post-gazette-holiday-cookie-challenge/stories/202611080006\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"\" title=\"https://www.post-gazette.com/life/recipes/2026/11/08/pittsburgh-post-gazette-holiday-cookie-challenge/stories/202611080006\">2026 Holiday Cookie Challenge</a> at the CCAC on Dec. 1, offers some simple tips to cut the angst while making your baking flow a little smoother.","type":"text"},{"_id":"RTUJPDZ3JNAGNIEVLOU5LCTXFI","additional_properties":{},"content":"<b>Get organized</b>","type":"text"},{"_id":"Q4HQCWYJ4VDEPAREF7TN7QABPA","additional_properties":{},"content":"One of the biggest mistakes bakers make is failing to be properly prepared, O’Connor says. That can lead to baking errors like forgetting ingredients or failing to preheat the oven or bring butter to room temperature or over (or under) mixing the batter.","type":"text"},{"_id":"YHDKP4SE45C4ZACMTTVNZH7C6E","additional_properties":{},"content":"For professional bakers, mise en place -- French for “everything in its place” -- is crucial.","type":"text"},{"_id":"FDE72TZGZJGVVBGZLJD3QNSPEI","additional_properties":{},"content":"Not only do you need to read the recipe top to bottom after clearing your counter space to make sure you understand the instructions. You also should gather all your tools and equipment, pre-measure every ingredient and line or grease your bakeware.","type":"text"},{"_id":"PHTY4FCCD5HZBOMKJMERQEWCYU","additional_properties":{},"content":"“You don’t want to get halfway through a recipe and find out you don’t have enough sugar,” O’Connor says. “Being organized and ready makes baking more enjoyable.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"OAMUPJJ3WZAJVHN7NUJ3GQWVZY","additional_properties":{},"content":"<b>Pay attention to the ingredient list </b>","type":"text"},{"_id":"MHS7ZEY7PJHHNOC33COPBPKEEM","additional_properties":{},"content":"When it comes to baking, words matter. If you use salted butter instead of unsalted, for instance, you’re adding sodium to the batter, which can alter the taste and texture of a cookie. Similarly, mistaking baking soda for baking powder changes the chemistry of your recipe. Baking soda needs both moisture and an acidic ingredient to act as a leavening agent, helping cookies to spread and brown. Baking powder -- which makes cookies rise -- requires moisture and heat. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"IW3VNZUJ55FSHKHXSXCB5AKK3A","additional_properties":{},"content":"Also keep a careful eye on the type of flour used. While most recipes call for all-purpose, some require lower-protein pastry flour for more delicate, crumbly cookies. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"YKI3LDPRJFHKLFXW5QKCXER75A","additional_properties":{},"content":"<b>Consider using a digital scale</b>","type":"text"},{"_id":"LQQCHFK2RVDRRGUOVNUCJM4YG4","additional_properties":{},"content":"Like all professional pastry chefs, O’Connor weighs recipe ingredients. Remember, baking is an exact science that relies on precise chemical reactions so even a slightest variance can change or ruin a recipe.","type":"text"},{"_id":"SNQ3B2GGJZBZTHFDT273PPRH6U","additional_properties":{},"content":"Measuring cups and spoons can vary in size and shape, so if you use them to measure ingredients when a recipe calls instead for grams, it won’t be as accurate. While that might not mean much in a single batch of cookies -- Santa will still wolf them down regardless -- it matters a lot when you are scaling a recipe up to six or seven dozen to feed a crowd.","type":"text"},{"_id":"3I5CZ5PI3NDOXCVJJ4FL7EJALU","additional_properties":{},"content":"<b>Don’t fret over fancy equipment</b>","type":"text"},{"_id":"XLIQHV33PJAHNIEM4W3RQ2RROM","additional_properties":{},"content":"Don’t have a KitchenAid mixer with a whisk attachment? No worries! An electric hand mixer or hand-held metal whisk works just as well. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"N4FU6XJIJ5FR5COAPM267HPXII","additional_properties":{},"content":"You can also use two forks to cut butter into flour if you don’t have a pastry cutter, and a wine bottle makes an OK substitute for a rolling pin. Snip off the corner of a plastic storage bag and you’ve got a pastry bag to pipe icing. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"CCFAODHGIZDLZN2EVQXRYJ4GP4","additional_properties":{},"content":"<b>Follow the right order</b>","type":"text"},{"_id":"JWTM4AD4ZFE25GBSU64FIWX5RY","additional_properties":{},"content":"To assure the proper texture, shape and structure to your cookie, it’s essential to add ingredients in the right order. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"4VK6ZXWLC5HRXOWK6BMMOYCLA4","additional_properties":{},"content":"Eggs and liquid extracts go in the bowl <i>after</i> fats and sugars have been creamed together. Dry ingredients -- which should be whisked in a separate bowl first --come next and should be mixed only until just combined. (Overmixing makes cookies tough.) Mix-ins like raisins, chocolate chips and nuts come last. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"IX6ZG6NSXJHAJG4JEJP4S2LRTE","additional_properties":{},"content":"<b>A word about rolling and resting</b>","type":"text"},{"_id":"P3RJ3JMXCNE7RHFGJEXX5NIAYE","additional_properties":{},"content":"Another common mistake novice bakers make is using too much force when rolling out cookie dough. Rolling up and down over the same spot actually will overwork it, says O’Connor.","type":"text"},{"_id":"27KRWTBRS5EPVFFE2BMYA3HIRQ","additional_properties":{},"content":"Instead, roll outward from the center using gentle pressure, and after a couple of passes, rotate the dough a quarter turn.","type":"text"},{"_id":"7PSFQZTYFRF6XKULMH3YRJWMFA","additional_properties":{},"content":"“You’re just trying to move the dough to fit the shape you want and the thickness you want,” he says. “You don’t want to hurt the dough or spread it.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"NYIUBLVZ3BDYRJGV4WOQGD2NYY","additional_properties":{},"content":"Another important note: If your recipe calls for chilling, let the dough rest in the refrigerator so the ","type":"text"},{"_id":"5GD55NGP35BYHGOXSO25WDS5IM","additional_properties":{},"content":"“It also helps to turn the pan halfway through baking to even the browning process,” he adds. Mellon University in 1982, the two developed a friendship that would last more than 40 years while building long careers at the university.","type":"text"},{"_id":"Y6FVTEXS4BEWZEYEPKX3IFSNTQ","additional_properties":{},"content":"Tademy, of Braddock, who spent 45 years at Carnegie Mellon advocating for underrepresented students and employees, and promoting equality in the workplace, died of natural causes on Oct. 26 at UPMC Shadyside Hospital. He was 74. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"PHQL5TOQX5HOPM2NA5FJCQ7KH4","additional_properties":{},"content":"“Everett was a very warm, compassionate and caring person, and very intellectual in his manner,” said Murphy, of Regent Square, a distinguished service professor and executive director of the Center for Leadership Studies at Carnegie Mellon. “He was an interesting, funny and charismatic person — I was drawn to him immediately.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"2S55WT2CHNA7DKJ6KZBX3HENVQ","additional_properties":{},"content":"Originally from Colfax, La., Tademy moved with his family to Oakland, Calif., where he graduated from Oakland High School in 1970. He earned a bachelor’s degree in political science from Reed College in Portland, Oregon, in 1974 before moving to Pittsburgh in 1975 to begin his career at Carnegie Mellon. He earned a master’s degree in public administration from the University of Pittsburgh in 1977.","type":"text"},{"_id":"T52GT766YFHMTMPLUUQFEH6RW4","additional_properties":{},"content":"Tademy joined CMU as a counselor with the Carnegie Mellon Action Project, which provided academic and career support to minority students. He later became assistant director of the university’s Upward Bound program before moving into federal contract compliance and human resources. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"AGBY4QMLSRC2NMANLBPKFGYIIE","additional_properties":{},"content":"He spent much of his later career as the university’s ombudsman, helping employees resolve workplace conflicts, before retiring in April 2020.","type":"text"},{"_id":"P6P5EJTUVNBFDEX6NSQCN4EJFY","additional_properties":{},"content":"“He wanted to help people,” said his wife, Sharon Tademy, of Braddock. “He wanted to help students and people succeed to make a better life for themselves.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"CNZWT3PWNBDWFHMMORVEG666LE","additional_properties":{},"content":"Murphy said Tademy’s knowledge of history and ability to understand different perspectives helped him navigate difficult situations. ","type":"text"},{"_id":"TUBBLV3JVRDSXCPXBNCILI756Y","additional_properties":{},"content":"“I think that framed his worldview, if you will, because he was so often trying to resolve conflicts, trying to resolve personal differences that people had,” Murphy said. “I think his deep sense of history contributed to that quite a bit.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"3HUB7WXTURBLROFVIXVYNAZWWM","additional_properties":{},"content":"Outside of work, Tademy was a Civil War history buff who enjoyed reading, cooking and listening to jazz. He and his wife occasionally traveled to jazz festivals in Chicago but preferred spending time at home surrounded by books and records. He also volunteered in the Pittsburgh community, including with Auberle, an organization that provides services to children and families.","type":"text"},{"_id":"JDR74KMFZ5FXPNENCWDN63JTEM","additional_properties":{},"content":"“Pittsburgh is a pretty aspirational place and a very caring place,” Murphy said. “I think that fit really well with Everett’s core values.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"AK465WRDLRAEXHPEO2UGVRALAI","additional_properties":{},"content":"Sharon said her husband’s compassion reminded her of something her mother taught her growing up.","type":"text"},{"_id":"WXAEXYZ3WVA35FTZZ5FXPVPBKI","additional_properties":{},"content":"“Charity begins at home before it spreads abroad,” she said. “To me, that was Everett, and that will always be the spirit of him.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"I73C2ZRNFFBDXNHUHXBFVVBYMA","additional_properties":{},"content":"Murphy said Tademy’s commitment to helping others extended beyond his professional life.","type":"text"},{"_id":"KGLJRRF3G5B2RE5OLGKRJFRJGY","additional_properties":{},"content":"“Everett was someone who lived his values,” he said. “His behaviors were reflective of his deepest values, and that’s not easy in life.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"Z7FL3FNYP5FGDAFRGVCNLMNLYQ","additional_properties":{},"content":"Sharon said her husband was more than just her partner.","type":"text"},{"_id":"VYRA6BB2G5BTLFYFKXVQJOAMWI","additional_properties":{},"content":"“He was more like a friend than a husband,” she said. “We were married for 48 years, but it doesn’t seem like it’s been that long.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"YSBH34GCVFHOPOOH4CK4MDQB5I","additional_properties":{},"content":"Tademy was preceded in death by his parents, William C. and Eva Vaughn Tademy, and grandparents, Nathan Green and Lenora Tademy. In addition to his wife, he is survived by his sister, Valerie Hodge Tademy; brothers, Cebron Ronell Tademy, Kurt Edward Tademy and Gavin Tademy; and numerous in-laws, nieces, nephews, cousins and extended family.","type":"text"},{"_id":"TKKFRVE6T5FUZHBNBZC2IGWPHM","additional_properties":{},"content":"<i>Ava Dzurenda (ava.dzurenda@gmail.com) is a science writer and exercise physiologist based in Squirrel Hill.</i>","type":"text"}],"first_publish_date":"2026-11-17T09:00:00Z","related_content":{"basic":[],"clonedChildren":[],"clonedFromParent":[]},"commentCount":0},{"_id":"AHLTI2Y6YDBHGZ7RAROR7TR3FI","canonical_website":"post-gazette","credits":{"by":[{"_id":"jacobgeanous","type":"author","version":"0.5.8","name":"Jacob Geanous","image":{"url":"https://author-service-images-prod-us-east-1.publishing.aws.arc.pub/baltimorebanner/W5FD7AEMPNEQZFJAVRXYM3E6TI.png","version":"0.5.8","type":"image","auth":{"1":"91717422fa2863eb4929109d4d2ce9480346256a8a4f2418a373f8d1b7a364d7"}},"description":"Jacob Geanous is a politics reporter for the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette. Emanuel — former Illinois congressman, Chicago mayor and U.S. ambassador to Japan — is rolling out an economy-focused, centrist reform message as he weighs a potential bid for the White House in 2028.","type":"text"},{"_id":"BNF7WIXBLRG6BFJQUJAQCA5N2E","content":"Emanuel, a Democrat, mapped out a vision Monday for his party as it comes off a sweeping victory in the Nov. 3 midterm elections during a speech at Carnegie Mellon University as part of the President’s Lecture Series.","type":"text"},{"_id":"XOJ2WDF5TRHTNHZEW3GM36ZQAM","content":"The longtime party fixture described what he sees as misguided distrust among a faction of progressive Democrats of the country’s free market system that could stymie any efforts to ultimately grow the economy.","type":"text"},{"_id":"HXBO2GVPMNFPDA3WMNQT5XYQD4","content":"“A wing of my party thinks the problem with capitalism is capitalism,’ he said. “They’re wrong.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"NNJH3MGMOJBCBBZH5L33GB7SKI","content":"He said the issue is instead “rampant corruption both in the political process, the economy and in our tax code, all of which is leading to an inexcusable level of inequity.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"57UB6JE6TFDC3AMMTUI5FHFSZI","content":"Emanuel, who also served as President Barack Obama’s chief of staff, said he sees the party as partially blind to the country’s economic potential as they focus on President Donald Trump’s turbulent second term in office.","type":"text"},{"_id":"F3VL5E3DPND57O3G65CKBYJTSY","content":"“The Democrats have allowed Trump to occupy so much of our brain that we have become intellectually lazy and politically timid,” he said. “We’ve spent so much time arguing over how to divide the pie that we forgot how to grow the pie and give the middle class a bigger share.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"XKQ6WB3L6RE4TDEKOO4DVBALJE","content":"Emanuel pointed to the rising median age of first-time home owners, which has reached a record-high of 40 years old, and said it is time to “clean house” in all three branches of federal government.","type":"text"},{"_id":"ZUKB3F35ZRFRFC7OKO2UOKPEUE","content":"“The moment the American Dream became unaffordable is exactly when American democracy became unstable,” he said.","type":"text"},{"_id":"MV5NHBIMPZDGTG4A63HUFIOQMA","content":"Emanuel went on to outline a list of policies he believes could be enacted immediately to root out corruption in government and restore trust in the political system.","type":"text"},{"_id":"2CE5HIJV3ZH2ZDAZZ43WGIYHQI","content":"Among them would be to ban all stock trading and participation in prediction markets for lawmakers.","type":"text"},{"_id":"QU3BA6M7BFESPNUAI6FQ652HGY","content":"Emanuel also said that a mandatory retirement age or term limits should be instituted in Washington, and those working in government should be banned from receiving foreign money or investments.","type":"text"},{"_id":"HLFUKEQ72VASNAU3ZNO4SUXFEI","content":"“Corruption is a cancer at the core of capitalism,\" he said.","type":"text"},{"_id":"WD75RI62TFBWPF6KNAX2UYOCIE","content":"In the private sector, Emanuel suggested closing loopholes that allow companies to stash profits overseas and proposed increasing the capital gains rate from 20% to 28%.","type":"text"},{"_id":"UQIJB2XYBJGODJJTPLD4JOLB4Q","content":"“That’s what it was under Ronald Reagan and Bill Clinton, when we saw the greatest job growth,” he said.","type":"text"},{"_id":"BDMUTPTXLFBKTNRSS5N7LXNGL4","content":"Throughout his remarks, Emanuel did not shy away from placing blame on his own party and pushed for bipartisan cooperation.","type":"text"},{"_id":"6JSOCCB6QVHYNETNTFZRNZJP34","content":"“President Bill Clinton and a Republican Congress balanced the budget and created four years in a row of surpluses,” said Emanuel, who served in the Clinton White House. “Since then, both parties have contributed to our fiscal calamity. We need to be honest about our history.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"X3SXN72GJ5CN7M66UZN3RIOR4M","content":"Increasing the federal minimum wage, restricting political lobbying, rolling back tariffs and lowering health care costs are among the issues Emmanuel said he believes both parties could agree on right away.","type":"text"},{"_id":"Q6XFWBAZQBBN3JHABPFM66LNWI","content":"“They would all pass with bipartisan support. … The task for Democrats is to take the winning coalition electorally and flip it to a governing coalition,” he said. “The people that won in South Carolina, Kansas, Texas and across the country could tell their voters ‘This is the change you want. This is what we’re delivering.’ ”","type":"text"},{"_id":"VZ7OA5IY7ZAZDGHW2XOY6QEZA4","content":"Emanuel said he believes the priorities he has seen from some Democratic Party factions have not aligned with tangible progress.","type":"text"},{"_id":"VJD2QLLC6NFCJIJ4IBYEQYOM2Y","content":"“Some in my own party have their own delusions,” he said. “We’re not going to create 6 to 8 million jobs just by gaining followers on TikTok, and we’re not going to grow the economy 3% a year just by legalizing pot.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"BASGYAGGVFGADNQSXZH3CWLUHM","content":"Instead, he said, to grow the middle class, the party needs to focus on education to support the country’s workforce.","type":"text"},{"_id":"QXON5GY6INGG5GZZKVOMBZTT2E","content":"“Our greatest resource is our people, and we as a nation have not been investing in them,” he said. “Today, half our kids cannot read at grade level.”","type":"text"},{"_id":"MUVKS55WGFEC5KFN3YLGHLXK2E","content":"Emanuel’s remarks come as Democrats look to mend a divide between the party’s progressive and moderate wings while simultaneously grappling with questions of whether to choose new party leaders as they prepare to take control of the U.S. House and Senate in January.","type":"text"},{"_id":"E3WTPQE5FFEMHHGEOOXDASMIQ4","content":"While Emanuel suggested a wide range of changes across the legislative, corporate, and educational spectrum, he did not specify whether his suggestion to “clean house” extends to those party leaders.","type":"text"},{"_id":"ATRYNLTS7BEQNKW72PUJTTCN4I","content":"Recently, Maryland Democratic Senator Chris Val Hollen announced he would be challenging New York Sen. is not a column about running the T to the airport. I’m all for bold ideas, but this one simply isn’t going to happen, ever. Tough geography, too expensive and minimal payoff — the light-rail ride to and from Downtown would take forever.","type":"text"},{"_id":"MM3OJ3YYPNABHDYWIOLUG5TUVM","additional_properties":{},"content":"This is not a column about running the T to Oakland. It’s also too expensive, and the University Line/PRTX bus rapid transit link serves that purpose just, or at least nearly, as well as a subway would.","type":"text"},{"_id":"QDCHT3AO4JBVHPKHCTMEGF72TI","additional_properties":{},"content":"This is not even a column about permanently restoring service on the Allentown Line, even though that wouldn’t be expensive at all and would be a boost to the Hilltop neighborhoods.","type":"text"},{"_id":"YYVC6B2TY5FCDC3FJOO7KTWOQI","additional_properties":{},"content":"No, this is a column about something much simpler even than that, something that drives me slightly batty every time I see the unused rails and platforms just waiting for a train to make them very useful once again. It’s about connecting Pittsburgh’s two best transit lines, the T and the East Busway, further linking the North Side and South Hills to the East End and beyond and bringing more riders into the transit system.","type":"text"},{"_id":"XE7TTRBA6NFJ3HSCPAPONRBWPU","additional_properties":{},"content":"It’s about using the one-third mile Penn Station light rail line once again.","type":"text"},{"_id":"PUKXT27KSRDE7JIOOG7MSWS5TI","additional_properties":{},"content":"Color by numbers","level":3,"type":"header"},{"_id":"2XSWHTDSYNHBTADIEBWPRJIEOY","additional_properties":{},"content":"If you travel to a big East Coast city like New York or Washington, one of the most important wayfinding devices is the color-coded transit map. These lines help visitors and residents alike orient themselves and therefore become features of neighborhood identity.","type":"text"},{"_id":"62624ZYZ5ZGE7AOGVRC7D4MXWQ","additional_properties":{},"content":"In Pittsburgh, by contrast, the old streetcar lines served this purpose, with many of those old numbers, like the 39 Brookline, being held over for bus routes. While this system worked great (and remains serviceable) for natives who know the system, a bus network that requires local knowledge or a decoder ring isn’t ideal for tourists or newcomers.","type":"text"},{"_id":"7JNN6OFIBZEZ7HH2RHCIDQELZQ","additional_properties":{},"content":"But that actually sells Pittsburgh short: The city also has one of the best fixed guideway transit networks — that is, routes where transit vehicles have an exclusive right-of-way — of any comparable town in America. This includes not just the T and the East Busway but the South Busway and the West Busway, any one of which transit advocates in peer cities would sacrifice an extremity to have locally.","type":"text"},{"_id":"RHYD3Z4SMRCADOFJKG3O2UHG4M","additional_properties":{},"content":"Pittsburgh Regional Transit has tried to market these as “lines” like big-city metros, to middling success. There’s Blue, Red and (kind of) Silver on the T, while East Busway routes are Purple, South Busway ones are Yellow and West Busway ones are Green. Then buses that use the Parkway North HOV lanes are Orange, but that’s cheating.","type":"text"},{"_id":"QKD7J4U7MVAWNH6ILHHBJMLLXM","additional_properties":{},"content":"Making connections","level":3,"type":"header"},{"_id":"QQEXGQQRIFEBNOMOP3VRN3GCTA","additional_properties":{},"content":"The problem, and I suspect one of the main reasons this system never really caught on, is that the color-coded “lines” rarely connect to one another. The T lines and the South Busway touch at South Hills Junction and South Bank, but despite a trail that terminates within site of that T station, you can’t walk there from Brookline. Meanwhile, the West Busway terminates at West Carson Street in the West End.","type":"text"},{"_id":"VEKCQ65LIFG7HK2GZJ3TMMVZZY","additional_properties":{},"content":"Color-coded buses do (generally) have consistent loops in Downtown, but there’s not much signage or mapping that helps people navigate that. The closest there is to a real connection is the Wood Street T Station, where University Line, East Busway and South Busway (but not West Busway) routes converge. This has made the corner of Sixth, Wood and Liberty crowded and confusing, not to mention a hub of police activity.","type":"text"},{"_id":"DPO3ENZYGRC37IROAO7JV6UCYI","additional_properties":{},"content":"In other cities with robust fixed-guideway systems, part of the appeal is that transfers within that system are relatively seamless. Once you’re “in the system,” you don’t have to do a lot of walking or complex navigation to reach your destination. Wayfinding guides within the system make it easy.","type":"text"},{"_id":"735BKEKYMNGE3HVEM4FFMU4ROA","additional_properties":{},"content":"In contrast, for anything but a straight-to-Downtown ride in Pittsburgh you typically have to piece together your route yourself.","type":"text"},{"_id":"BPUZVD2NJFFINCMHAMKZ6A3DBY","additional_properties":{},"content":"Low cost, high benefit","level":3,"type":"header"},{"_id":"6VZMDVDF6BETZLLG7UHSBJLF7U","additional_properties":{},"content":"There is, however, a way to alleviate the pressure on Wood Street and reduce friction for transit riders. Better still, it’s one PRT knows can work because the authority uses it during construction and on special occasions: the single line connector between Steel Plaza and Penn Station.","type":"text"},{"_id":"HZHEPIO3YBD53CCJO46ZYKUTYI","additional_properties":{},"content":"Running a simple, free light-rail shuttle on this line would provide a direct connection from the terminus of the East Busway into the T system, and vice versa, without having to navigate Downtown at all. A rider from, for instance, Dormont or Bethel Park could go straight to East Liberty or Swissvale without ever leaving the fixed-guideway system. The whole thing would only require a few dozen steps between platforms at Steel Plaza and at Penn Station.","type":"text"},{"_id":"HAVW4725ZJFKBKWCYHDTE65RO4","additional_properties":{},"content":"I understand the reason this does not exist is that, when it did exist, the service consistently rated dead last in PRT for cost versus revenue. But I’d argue that the benefits to the system are greater than can be directly measured: By seamlessly uniting the East Busway and the T, you encourage people to use the system who wouldn’t have otherwise. And you keep them in the system once they’re there.","type":"text"},{"_id":"ZDA3R6ZMG5DK5G2NUWFLLFOEIE","additional_properties":{},"content":"Due to changing usage patterns, inconsistent state funding and massive legacy liabilities, PRT is constantly in cost-cutting mode. cast."},{"_id":"WIOGYN3B6RDK3AQQGNXUL27ZNE","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Back at UPMC Rooney Sports Complex on Monday, Mike McCarthy noted how McCormick was still upbeat and else.”"},{"_id":"FU642CAUWJDJPLEB6XYE4OC7GE","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"McCormick’s contributions were most evident in the Steelers’ run game, which averages 4.8 yards per carry this season, fourth best in the NFL. The 6-foot-5, 315-pound fourth-round pick from the 2024 NFL Draft is often seen at the point of attack in the run game and is a key communicator for the offensive line."},{"_id":"6IAMS6GTOBCONGLQ34VM4QGH6U","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"But to replace McCormick, the Steelers will turn to a player who lost his starting right guard position earlier in the season — Spencer Anderson."},{"_id":"TEC6XCG43BFXZCQD4CYCVH2P7A","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“Spencer’s just a 360 football player, in my view,” McCarthy said. “He started out as our right guard and then showed the ability to play left guard. ... He’s a gifted football player. So this will be his opportunity.”"},{"_id":"FLN7VTCALFC2DJ55JAKRYAUGYA","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Anderson, a former Steelers seventh-round pick, has played more than 500 snaps in his career. Going into this season, he was tasked with replacing McCormick at right guard after McCormick moved over to the left side."},{"_id":"BZUY6ABTIJFS7N2YHMBCBPTHJU","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"But Anderson struggled in his first two starts, including four pressures and a sack allowed against the New England Patriots in Week 2. That led to Anderson being benched in favor of Brock Hoffman for the Steelers’ first game against the Bengals."},{"_id":"QJVNLNF6LZF4PBENCHGF26I25M","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"But Anderson has remained a useful tool for the offense, as he’s been their extra offensive lineman in heavy packages to help open up the run game. They were blown out in Week 2, on the road in New England."},{"_id":"L6OJXS5PVJDPND2T4GME275YJM","type":"text","content":"Following that loss, I noted how well the Steelers responded from lopsided losses under Mike Tomlin and <a href=\"https://www.post-gazette.com/sports/steelers/2026/09/25/noah-hiles-mike-mccarthy-mike-tomlin/stories/202609220035\" target=\"_blank\">questioned if McCarthy could replicate those results</a>. — On Thursday, Mike McCarthy was asked to identify the biggest difference in his team since its first matchup against the Cincinnati Bengals."},{"_id":"634PSJMS4FBQPAZYKYSDPJ6SWQ","type":"text","content":"“Confidence,” the Steelers coach said. “And that comes with winning. Every time you win, a chunk of confidence goes with it.”"},{"_id":"IMYNULCR2ZFCLBIFCMINC5OBZE","type":"text","content":"It’s safe to suggest that confidence will be tested following the second showdown."},{"_id":"EI22X7B6MFFG7MTD2RIZFZ52X4","type":"text","content":"The Steelers didn’t just lose to a division foe Sunday evening. They were mercilessly humiliated for 60 minutes in front of a national audience. They also suffered losses in the injury department, ones that could change the outlook of their season moving forward."},{"_id":"TV5YNA572BDJXBFYJLVUGBL7LE","type":"text","content":"With the toughest stretch of the schedule ahead, a tough look in the mirror awaits."},{"_id":"JES6B74AB5GIRAGMDYV56WD27Q","type":"text","content":"“That’s clearly not the standard of the Pittsburgh Steelers,” McCarthy said after the loss. “That wasn’t to any of our expectations.”"},{"_id":"EGFOVW2EXJDLHDU7XWOAYSMAW4","type":"text","content":"The Bengals wasted no time showing what type of night the Steelers were in for."},{"_id":"CQYJ7GZN7JDEHCAZVCURQLVTSY","type":"text","content":"Cincinnati dominated the opening period, possessing the football for 14 of the first 15 minutes. That momentum rolled over into the second quarter, when the Bengals built a 24-3 lead heading into the break."},{"_id":"QXWX64UXPJF55JQWI3HID7XSXA","type":"text","content":"Cincinnati outgained the Steelers 337 yards to 40 in the opening half. Joe Burrow tallied a game’s worth of production in that stretch, completing 26 of his 34 passes for 302 yards and three touchdowns. The same went for Ja’Marr Chase, who had seven catches for 146 yards."},{"_id":"BOKATA5V2VFJTMTZMUT2MEBXEQ","type":"text","content":"The Steelers offense, meanwhile, was lifeless. Aaron Rodgers delivered one of his worst performances ever, starting 0 for 8 from the air. The run game wasn’t much better, resulting in three punts in their first three possessions."},{"_id":"ISDC56TRW5HMBMKE54KD25VOMM","type":"text","content":"“We kinda shot ourselves in the foot with a couple of plays,” Rodgers said. “We couldn’t get anything going.”"},{"_id":"WTKGYFO3KREHJF6GXDBTZ732C4","type":"text","content":"Any hope of a comeback effort quickly vanished early in the third quarter. Rodgers was beaten to a pulp by the Bengals defensive front, taking a pair of sacks on the opening drive of the second half."},{"_id":"OTAD6SITVFGNVJ4VN7NA4L6A7U","type":"text","content":"Cincinnati got the ball back and killed 6:34 off the clock before reaching the end zone again. That score made it a four-possession game and gave Steelers Nation an excuse to head to bed early."},{"_id":"FJ5IM54XHJAPZKZM2YN24OI3ME","type":"text","content":"The final score was closer than the game looked due to a few Steelers touchdowns in garbage time. But make no mistake — this loss was the ugliest of the season."},{"_id":"RXQJPSZYCFDKFKX72WB3BPSFFY","type":"text","content":"“Give credit to the Bengals. They played extremely well,” McCarthy said. “They played the game they wanted to play. We didn’t get the game heading in the direction we wanted to play.”"},{"_id":"4VFJRNL6DBEDNLTFUZ23XLMP2M","type":"text","content":"The pain wasn’t limited to the scoreboard, either. The Steelers also suffered a pair of crucial injuries."},{"_id":"DAG6YAML3ZAFDCRQQCOPV5P7DU","type":"text","content":"First was safety DeShon Elliott, who tweaked his knee during pregame warmups. Then came left guard Mason McCormick, who was carted off the field late in the second quarter with an ankle injury."},{"_id":"R2PICRX66VEDFIKV7BL56MHQQM","type":"text","content":"The former is needed to help the defense’s weakest area, but he has struggled to stay healthy all season. The latter is the heart and soul of the offensive line — not the unit’s best talent but a key piece to the operation."},{"_id":"MVPUCXDUCVBULKS2PHHV2TGEQQ","type":"text","content":"Both are significant losses at a time when McCarthy’s team will need all hands on deck. The schedule doesn’t get any easier for the Black and Gold."},{"_id":"UASJ3KOD5BCL7LUHLGFDYO6444","type":"text","content":"The Steelers will travel to Philadelphia next weekend, a location where they haven’t won since Lyndon B. Johnson was in office. After that comes matchups against the Denver Broncos, Houston Texans and Jacksonville Jaguars."},{"_id":"KQJWQZLYDJCVXJF5LZ3LVLN74M","type":"text","content":"Two of those teams will be in the postseason this year. The third embarrassed them at home last January."},{"_id":"6EIB3BHC5NGQBNFGI3P4WE4QDE","type":"text","content":"“It’s one loss,” McCarthy said when asked how the Steelers can prevent this defeat from causing them to spiral. “ ... We’re not gonna drive down Drama Road and waste time with those types of things.”"},{"_id":"TU75UAPF3ZF3HM2XBK47N2MMWI","type":"text","content":"It would be wrong to suggest the sky is completely falling. Sunday’s loss counts the same as the two others McCarthy’s team has suffered this year."},{"_id":"DW4V2NEQNBGGHON4ZOFB4QTQ3M","type":"text","content":"But there’s no denying this one stings more. The Steelers had a chance to make a statement, to take control of the AFC North and earn a series sweep over a team some analysts view to be a Super Bowl contender."},{"_id":"P74AT3BOBFG2LBV5OINLLFA64Y","type":"text","content":"Instead, they fell flat."},{"_id":"YQNILMMVAZHHFPAJREP7LBLHWA","type":"text","content":"Now, it’s on McCarthy and his players to pick up the pieces and regroup before the momentum they built throughout October is completely squandered."}],"subheadlines":{"basic":""},"description":{"basic":""},"source":{"system":"Libercus","source_id":"202611150104"},"taxonomy":{"sections":[{"path":"/topic/sports/steelers","parent":{"default":"/topic/sports"},"_website":"post-gazette","parent_id":"/topic/sports","name":"Steelers","_id":"/topic/sports/steelers","additional_properties":{"original":{"parent":{"default":"/topic/sports","sub-navigation-bar":"/","hamburger-menu":"/topic/sports"},"website":"post-gazette","metadata":{"metadata_title":"Steelers - — Post-Gazette reporter Ray Fittipaldo grades each aspect of the Steelers’ 38-18 loss against the Bengals:</em>"},{"level":2,"_id":"IQXJGYCZY5AZXI3ZSDOW6SSZBY","type":"header","content":"Quarterback"},{"_id":"ISDHTZXMTNBATBXZPXIXQCSF6U","type":"text","content":"Aaron Rodgers started the game 0 for 8 and did not complete his first pass until 4:21 remained in the second quarter. To say that was the worst start to a game in Rodgers’ 22-year career wouldn’t be overstating it — he had never gone 0 for 5 to open a game before Sunday night."},{"_id":"JIONUARKZBCVLNOEZ33V3PKCYU","type":"text","content":"By the time Rodgers completed a pass, the Bengals had a 17-0 lead. He was 4 for 12 for 25 yards at halftime, when the Steelers trailed 24-3. What should be concerning for the Steelers is the Bengals defense isn’t very good. It entered the game 25th in total defense and allowed Cam Ward and the Tennessee Titans to score 36 points two weeks ago."},{"_id":"EANLYWK6DNEDVJD6FEBUQAVHYU","type":"text","content":"<strong>Grade: F</strong>"},{"level":2,"_id":"252SJ6OLE5FQ5H2DG4SAS6REBY","type":"header","content":"Running backs"},{"_id":"TKCZ6NO2UJABRBI55PKHGW2QVY","type":"text","content":"Jaylen Warren accounted for 176 yards from scrimmage in the first game against the Bengals, but he was ineffective in the rematch. He had only seven rushing yards at halftime and finished with a season-low 15 for the game. Rico Dowdle wasn’t much better, with 26 yards on five attempts."},{"_id":"3OCS22SY7RGZJMZNITFRSEWQPE","type":"text","content":"The longest run of the game by the Steelers was by third-stringer Lew Nichols in garbage time against the Bengals’ reserves. That about sums up the kind of night it was for the offense."},{"_id":"AYPHUK4TTVGVBHOGDBAHRISKLU","type":"text","content":"<strong>Grade: D</strong>"},{"level":2,"_id":"MKREZHLT2JD5XHYXI4NBBSTG5A","type":"header","content":"Receivers"},{"_id":"TO3R6RDI6NDMFFHMSBGVLSFL3A","type":"text","content":"General manager Omar Khan’s decision to not upgrade his receiving corps at the trade deadline will be heavily criticized after the Steelers failed to get open against a Bengals secondary that came into the game giving up 228 yards per contest."},{"_id":"NOCXP6Z2LFEFTLNLWCED2BVM7Y","type":"text","content":"The first three receptions for the Steelers went to running backs and tight ends. It wasn’t until Ben Skowronek caught a pass on a broken play with 1:40 left before halftime that a receiver caught a pass."},{"_id":"KBLNVE2VSZACXA4ZLMB46DK2NY","type":"text","content":"DK Metcalf, the highest-paid player on the Steelers offense, did not make a catch until the fourth quarter. The one time he was noticeable in the first half was when he lined up offsides, a penalty that negated a 13-yard gain by Warren."},{"_id":"CQVUALY7FNAXRLGQLPIGW5RZEY","type":"text","content":"One has to wonder if major changes are forthcoming. Max Hurleman and Marquez Valdes-Scantling are on the practice squad. They can’t do any worse than the compilation of players Rodgers throws to now, can they?"},{"_id":"PXD7OZUJ3VE65PF7NSL63YUCFE","type":"text","content":"<strong>Grade: F</strong>"},{"level":2,"_id":"EWPXKSO5VZCQ7AXHF7NDLRGNUA","type":"header","content":"Offensive line"},{"_id":"WOWAHVPN3VFGPFSMN6EDMSKATI","type":"text","content":"When the Steelers don’t run the ball well, their linemen are exposed in pass protection. The Bengals shut down Warren and Dowdle, then teed off on Rodgers, sacking him three times."},{"_id":"2R3XQ63OG5DV7EAZZMZ3M3D6KU","type":"text","content":"Rodgers was sacked on consecutive plays on the opening series of the second half. Left tackle Troy Fautanu was beaten by Myles Murphy for the first one, then Brock Hoffman failed to pick up Boye Mafe, who came in untouched on an inside stunt."},{"_id":"GE3GZITSANFW5NUIVNOH5BXYQA","type":"text","content":"In addition to the playing perhaps its worst game of the season, the line could be without starting left guard Mason McCormick for quite some time. McCormick was carted off the field with an ankle injury late in the first half."},{"_id":"PF4T3FIFQFHC5L4MJSEW7QJMNE","type":"text","content":"<strong>Grade: F</strong>"},{"level":2,"_id":"EIGJP22CURBAPKXEMQYETNTKME","type":"header","content":"Defensive line"},{"_id":"55IOZU4E25FXDP7CQGAJREGBYY","type":"text","content":"Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow stepped up in the pocket on numerous occasions as he carved up the defense. The interior linemen didn’t get enough pressure up the middle to keep Burrow in the pocket. That was one of the biggest keys to the game."},{"_id":"LYX7ILFVJVGJLCJJ5BKN6FYS2I","type":"text","content":"The Bengals don’t even attempt to run, so if the linemen don’t stay in their rush lanes, Burrow is going to pick apart any defense. Cam Heyward, Keeanu Benton and Derrick Harmon each had one tackle. That’s not going to cut it against a quarterback like Burrow."},{"_id":"6ZPSSOR4NZH6PO75SABZ33SUSQ","type":"text","content":"<strong>Grade: F</strong>"},{"level":2,"_id":"XM2D7ACLTVCS5DONS7M6FD4BIQ","type":"header","content":"Linebackers"},{"_id":"JNHLE75IRVBHDJ7O74RBDDPEKI","type":"text","content":"The Steelers had eight sacks in their previous outing against the Cleveland Browns, but they couldn’t bother Burrow with any significant pressure Sunday."},{"_id":"INDLQKWBCJH6DCSR73DCJ5UVBY","type":"text","content":"Patrick Queen had a sack in the first half, but when the outside linebackers got close to him, he simply stepped up and made a play. Payton Wilson finished the game with 19 tackles and Queen had 14, but most of those were well down the field after Bengals players caught the ball."},{"_id":"4MFT4DO3SRGKLK7TGHQ2NMLTII","type":"text","content":"<strong>Grade: D</strong>"},{"level":2,"_id":"YDPNUM6KAVEJZGFWZSBBDXWQUQ","type":"header","content":"Secondary"},{"_id":"M7GJ4J7BWFDPDDO7BZHVTXXK5U","type":"text","content":"Burrow might very well win NFL MVP, but David Klingler and Akili Smith — Bengals QB busts of the past — would have had field days against the Steelers on Sunday night."},{"_id":"GJSSRKFGQFAGFK4BVAHSIGZUOU","type":"text","content":"Bengals receivers were running wide open all game long. Ja’Marr Chase had 11 receptions for 231 yards, and Tee Higgins had five for 66."},{"_id":"O5JHX2ATIRCGRH6D7CWLKTIXIE","type":"text","content":"It didn’t matter if the Steelers played man-to-man or zone — Burrow was dropping dimes all night long. Cornerback Asante Samuel Jr. struggled in the first matchup against the Bengals, and Burrow went after him time and time again."},{"_id":"R55BFOPGUZFFDPBS2BLXUPG6CY","type":"text","content":"<strong>Grade: F</strong>"},{"level":2,"_id":"YTRQWGBKYFEBJJ2BBRFTYA3RVU","type":"header","content":"Special teams"},{"_id":"VQSJHGXQPZFWLPK6Q6TIIKQS4U","type":"text","content":"Cameron Johnston got in a good workout, trotting out to punt five times. And hey, Chris Boswell provided the only points for the Steelers through the first three quarters."},{"_id":"BQ55KP4Z65B7BJDZOYRVMLUPAE","type":"text","content":"Other than that, it was same old, same old for the special teams. Rookie returner Kaden Wetjen didn’t provide any splash plays to spark the offense. At some point, the Steelers should try someone else back there. Either that or teach the players in front of him to block better."},{"_id":"E6BCJBC4ERH5NC7EHQN6WMJXMA","type":"text","content":"<strong>Grade: D</strong>"},{"level":2,"_id":"X5M3QI4QI5DRRMALXVV2AMPTF4","type":"header","content":"Coaching"},{"_id":"IFRNSAPHTND3FCXT33SEIWQUUY","type":"text","content":"The Steelers had to run the ball well if they were going to have a chance to quiet the crowd and beat the Bengals."},{"_id":"LPYTXP5HXFCWVLEYK7IRA56454","type":"text","content":"If that was the game plan, they never had a chance to execute it because the Bengals possessed the ball for 14 of the 15 minutes in the first quarter and jumped out to a 10-0 lead. They ran 25 plays to the Steelers’ six early in the game. It was pretty much over at that point because there was no way the defense was going to keep Burrow in check."},{"_id":"OYYZWEB6T5ET5MR5IKRQP2S3ZY","type":"text","content":"Defensive coordinator Patrick Graham came out of the gates with pressure packages to hurry Burrow, but he eluded the pressure and made Graham pay for his aggressiveness — not that sitting back in zones would have been a much better idea. Graham needed better execution by his players, who failed to keep Burrow contained in the pocket or cover his receivers."},{"_id":"W7Y3ITEHJZEF5OXAQSHV6JA75U","type":"text","content":"<strong>Grade: — It was difficult to tell which team might have been suffering from jet lag and which looked refreshed coming off of a bye week."},{"_id":"IX3424E2XJEXVMUILJCP25FZSY","type":"text","content":"The Steelers certainly didn’t look like a team that was well rested."},{"_id":"YCJ6LRHFRBACNP7LCLQKQJR6KQ","type":"text","content":"Not when it appeared they might have still been sleeping."},{"_id":"LFPMB4LESNCKFGVHBLYLGB3RZQ","type":"text","content":"On a White Out night at Paycor Stadium, it was the Steelers who were waving the white flag after being humbled by the Cincinnati Bengals 38-18 on Sunday."},{"_id":"XIJEMN6W4ZBA3OKSRMCLO274QE","type":"text","content":"“I was very disappointed,” coach Mike McCarthy said. “We’re all disappointed.”"},{"_id":"BS35LGAUU5GBDMXALALN6UQFAE","type":"text","content":"It was also difficult to tell which was the main source of the disappointment."},{"_id":"AG3HUB5DLJDVBO6FG6CEXF2LMU","type":"text","content":"The Steelers No. 2-ranked defense was shredded by Joe Burrow, who passed for 409 yards and four touchdowns — 302 yards and three scores coming in the first half alone, when the Bengals stormed to a 24-3 halftime lead."},{"_id":"BHWLE6JGBFEDTJWHKUHOJHHP2Y","type":"text","content":"“We got our ass kicked,” defensive lineman Cam Heyward said."},{"_id":"XAL5ZWGXAVBCJFBCREZP3H4TSM","type":"text","content":"And the offense didn’t get a first down until the middle of the second quarter. Aaron Rodgers, who threw for 116 of his 143 yards in the fourth quarter, didn’t complete his first pass until 4:21 remained in the half."},{"_id":"2YI3WRGDSBAM5MFZSQZHLSN6TY","type":"text","content":"“I’m not happy with the way we performed on offense,” Rodgers said. “We started really slow and couldn’t get going until the fourth quarter.”"},{"_id":"JIIDHANWMNB7PLE4RMXL2SA44A","type":"text","content":"The loss ended their four-game winning streak and put the Bengals (7-2) alone in first place in the AFC North, a game ahead of the Steelers (6-3)."},{"_id":"DLTO2O3WAJFATIJ5TBYYGLD22Y","type":"text","content":"The Steelers were on their way to their worst defeat since a 38-3 loss in Buffalo on Oct. 9, 2022, until Rodgers threw pair of fourth-quarter touchdowns of 22 yards to DK Metcalf and 27 yards to tight end Pat Freiermuth."},{"_id":"KWG3RAFIXJBAPKXDB5QMDIPWS4","type":"text","content":"“I’ve been a part of this league for a long time,” Rodgers said. “There’s big wins. There’s tough losses. We’ll deal with this appropriately.”"},{"_id":"WVOD56SKOZA5VHKBTA4WFJ66BA","type":"text","content":"The Steelers didn’t see this one coming, not after winning four in a row and coming off of their most complete game of the season against the Cleveland Browns."},{"_id":"JPW2VT2GMFFCZDY4AP6XOCS46I","type":"text","content":"But maybe it’s not such a surprise."},{"_id":"FQH6IPUFA5FMPLZNNN3CCSQIJE","type":"text","content":"After they beat the Browns 27-6 on Nov. 1, the Steelers didn’t practice again for 10 days. The time off apparently had a negative effect — their defense was picked apart, and the offense sleepwalked through 3 1/2 quarters."},{"_id":"CVKC6B46OJEL5MPDI5EXCGH55E","type":"text","content":"“Handling success is the biggest challenge in this league,” McCarthy said. “Coming off a bye week, you worry about a lot of that. I’ve seen it happen before.”"},{"_id":"G7ZF2RJRURDWDGXTVF3QZYDA34","type":"text","content":"It certainly happened against the Bengals."},{"_id":"6WBSLUPP6BEE5H5WTEW3T75PMM","type":"text","content":"And it happened in front of their former coach Mike Tomlin, who apparently lent his successor one of his famous catchphrases."},{"_id":"ONLJ3NBKJNGOZO6HSGF5SB3I2Q","type":"text","content":"“That’s clearly not the standard of the Pittsburgh Steelers,” McCarthy said. “It’s not just to any of our expectations.”"},{"_id":"FDAUPHCSBVAILJMZ3S2HKA2HCI","type":"text","content":"Burrow, who threw for more than 400 yards for the third time this season, completed 34 of 44 attempts and was just sacked once. He had an easy time playing pitch and catch all night with receivers Ja’Marr Chase and Tee Higgins. Chase tied his season high with 11 catches for a season-best 231 yards, while Higgins had five receptions for 66 yards."},{"_id":"POZOQ4VZERCYHAYFBDNVTW2XJQ","type":"text","content":"Burrow has thrown 20 touchdowns and the Bengals have averaged 36.2 points during their five-game winning streak, stamping the seventh-year quarterback as the leading candidate to be the league’s MVP."},{"_id":"ZYGUVZAQHJGRLNRFEUNHDI7DUA","type":"text","content":"And the Steelers never had an answer. Now, McCarthy has to find some before the Steelers go back on the road to Philadelphia next Sunday."},{"_id":"4SUKFVZT7NG2DLPG7253HEULFY","type":"text","content":"“This is the first time we’ve been through one of these as a football team,” McCarthy said. “So it’s going to be an experience to go through it, correct it, how fast we move through that process and get on to Philadelphia because we’ve got to get back on the winning track.”"},{"_id":"QO2IG3IAWNEXPIXVVYHMB2JJGI","type":"text","content":"On a night when the Bengals wore all white and placed white towels to wave on every seat in Paycor Stadium, they did a good job white-washing the Steelers from the very start."},{"_id":"ZOKTPZYVBJAFTLEIKMVFXCLGIA","type":"text","content":"They had an overwhelming advantage in first downs (22-4), yards (337-41) and plays (44-20) in the first half, when they ran out to a 24-3 halftime lead against one of the league’s stingiest defenses."},{"_id":"UWALIGZBGZHHBGQ5RBZSROHF3Y","type":"text","content":"The Steelers even got a break when Bengals kicker Evan McPherson, who hadn’t missed a field goal in 41 attempts this season, was wide right on a 43-yard attempt when it was 10-0."},{"_id":"JVIQAVTIBVAD7HE3YPGSBHZZE4","type":"text","content":"But all that did was delay the inevitable."},{"_id":"QJ2FHVQJGZCUJE3HB5VT6BYRX4","type":"text","content":"Burrow needed only five plays, including a 53-yard completion to Chase, to go 80 yards and throw a two-yard touchdown to running back Chase Brown to make it 17-0."},{"_id":"E763TQNEWZEVXNCBLI3Y5SP3JM","type":"text","content":"“We have to own it,” Heyward said. “It’s one game. We’re going to address it in practice and get after it.”"},{"_id":"WM5FNQW4JFD5REEVFDRQNTUB5A","type":"text","content":"Said Rodgers: “We played a division opponent on the road and got beat up pretty good. I think you’ve got to learn to deal with this properly and be very self-critical. willing to take that risk."},{"_id":"DG4AXUT4UFBG7IMXQ52DDB6RFY","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"The Pirates protected two prospects from the draft on Tuesday, adding outfielder Mitch Jebb and catcher Axiel Plaz to the 40-man roster before the 6 p.m. deadline. They now have 40 players on their 40-man roster. "},{"_id":"VVMFVVHJOBFA7HKWFYSUJCQC6U","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Of those, Plaz is the headliner and the more surprising decision. The 21-year-old is ranked as the Pirates’ No. 7 prospect, per MLB Pipeline. FanGraphs considers him as the No. 3 prospect in the system and No. 76 in baseball."},{"_id":"VKVYCA3EVRBM5DCRQIXUWECGVA","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"The surprise comes in that Plaz is far from the majors. The Venezuelan backstop batted .305 with 18 homers, 74 RBIs and a .902 OPS last season, spent entirely at High-A Greensboro. He’s still developing defensively and played 20 games at first base, with some questioning whether he’ll stick at catcher long term. He did show improvement defensively in 2026."},{"_id":"4LHT4AE7AFGWPNKH723FPGNCAM","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"However, there aren’t any questions about the bat. Plaz, a right-handed hitter, hit .275 with a .963 OPS against lefties and .314 with an .884 OPS against right-handers. He had similar numbers home and away, notable in homer-happy Greensboro, and struck out just 17.2% of the time."},{"_id":"TLXBESE7DZGMTNGZVUTC3HYVBM","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Because of his age and lack of time above High-A, Plaz probably won’t help the Pirates in 2027. A 2028 debut seems more likely."},{"_id":"ZFHA462TFNCH3DNXJQHFUM5JFA","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Jebb, who spent much of the 2026 season at Triple-A Indianapolis, is seen as much more major league-ready."},{"_id":"WUZENNPXAVHRNAIYRD6PWBTQ2E","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"The 24-year-old outfielder batted .274 with eight homers, 38 RBIs and a .784 OPS last season in 76 games between four affiliates, including 55 games in Triple-A. He’s best known for his speed, stealing 76 bases in 2024 and 2025, though he didn’t run as much in 2026 after missing nearly three months with a fractured left thumb. "},{"_id":"UJUQHEZ77NFARN4LMQTVSAVB3Q","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"But Jebb made major strides, revamping his swing to add more power. He’ll never be known as a slugger, as he played 122 games for Altoona in 2025 without a single blast, but the lefty-swinging outfielder increased his average exit velocities last season and finished with an .839 OPS at Indianapolis."},{"_id":"2QJNBFPLMBBRFHJ3KWBVOJ5JVU","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Jebb was originally a shortstop, drafted in the second round out of Michigan State in 2023. He’s on track to become the third Pirate from that draft class to reach the majors, joining No. 1 pick Paul Skenes and 12th-rounder Khristian Curtis."},{"_id":"J2F2PBPEYFFW3MKIZBKUGZ6ZLA","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Because both Jebb and Plaz are now on the 40-man roster, they are considered part of the major league roster and cannot play, even in the minors, if the upcoming lockout leads to missed major league games. Those off the 40-man roster will be unaffected by the lockout."},{"_id":"6L6UXQ75ZRE4DHCOOND7NDYT5M","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"The Pirates did leave a few prospects unprotected, though there’s no guarantee any would be selected. Those who remain eligible include former top pick Termarr Johnson, Triple-A relievers Derek Diamond and Brandon Neeck, Double-A outfielder Lonnie White Jr. and High-A prospects Yordany De Los Santos and Tony Blanco Jr."},{"_id":"MGU4FELJY5EERJ6WW7PF7YLJ2M","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"The Rule 5 draft is scheduled for this year’s winter meetings, which will be canceled by the Dec. 1 lockout. It may or may not be made up."},{"_id":"A6XA3YR2BBEY5EUKMDIZXMTUAM","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"<b>Pirates sign McCormick</b>"},{"_id":"PK4KXDH6XRH3VNSIYAWWK6OCME","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"On Monday, the Pirates signed outfielder Chas McCormick to a minor league deal with an invitation to spring training, sources told the Post-Gazette."},{"_id":"SI5M5B7755BPZCUHVF34OGZLCU","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"McCormick, 31, played 502 games for the Houston Astros from 2021 to 2025 but spent all of 2026 at Triple-A Iowa (Cubs). He had 22 homers, 70 RBIs and an .842 OPS with the Astros in 2023, but finished with a sub-.600 OPS in both 2024 and 2025."},{"_id":"A6VD4XLEBNDYNKEQ3TRQNIWPAY","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"McCormick will presumably be used as minor league depth at Triple-A Indianapolis in 2027. "},{"_id":"2DYPKOUVQ5DN7ANSZPFTZE3V6A","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"For example, about 10 years ago, the state contracted with Plenary Walsh Keystone Partners on a five-year Rapid Bridge Replacement Program to replace more than 550 small bridges with similar designs for $942 million. That project worked because the contractor could buy a large amount of precast concrete beams at a lower price, then use them on a variety of projects."},{"_id":"BIRWEV2MGBCOXGKDF5Z3KNU6LI","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Grant Ervin, vice president for external affairs at Fay, said the firm has been aware of the city’s bridge problems because it has been located here for decades. It decided to propose the Pittsburgh program after its success as a contractor and construction manager on a $2.3 billion PennDOT program to replace or rehabilitate six major bridges, including four on Interstate 80."},{"_id":"6S7IGGZGW5DT3ECVEX7XLSXCOM","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Fay proposed a program for seven bridges in a variety of sizes and conditions as an example, Ervin said, to gauge PennDOT’s interest in the concept. If the state approves the concept, the company would work closely with the city to determine which bridges to improve."},{"_id":"XQ2XAFACHJBB3N4JM7BGUHRPPQ","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Then the project would go out for bids and any contractor could submit the lowest price to do the work."},{"_id":"ZQ6IJGGQUBGC3JBOXGL54SSBO4","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“We’re not necessarily wedded to the bridges included in the proposal,” Ervin said. “The concept is the package of projects all moving ahead at the same time. We can work with the city to determine which bridges are best to include.”"},{"_id":"INOJHVVSE5GJBPRFV3SMTQPJNA","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Although Pittsburgh’s bridges rarely follow a similar design to allow mass purchasing of supplies, Ervin said, the savings would come from using groups of designers and engineers to work on several projects at once. Additionally, costs inevitably go up over time, so it would be less expensive to work on numerous projects at once rather than one after the other."},{"_id":"NNN2NW3WRJGZ7P5Z5QDX62MJ7A","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“The concept is based on procurement, resource allocation and defined geography, the 55 square miles of the city of Pittsburgh,” Ervin said."},{"_id":"6OGW2VN3AVAELHLIMG7ZKPWONA","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"The concept could lead to a series of bridges being finished in five to seven years, often the time it takes to design and build one structure. explore, secure, and build the industries critical to it.”"},{"_id":"Y3INUUMSPVFJXGL2BHAWZIQKJY","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Pennsylvania leaders think the Keystone State — and "},{"_id":"SJXQKDJS6RGVHPW4ZCHGN6OW3E","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Leaders in <a href=\"https://www.spaceflorida.gov/ussa\" rel=\"\">Florida</a>, <a href=\"https://governorsoffice.colorado.gov/governor/news/governor-polis-and-lt-governor-primavera-announce-colorados-submission-host-united-states\" rel=\"\">Colorado </a>and <a href=\"https://commerce.maryland.gov/press-room/maryland-announces-efforts-house-us-space-academy\" rel=\"\">Maryland</a> are arguing the same for their respective states in their submitted proposals to host the academy. Each state is jockeying not only to sell itself as the next hub of space education and innovation, but as the most ready to meet the President’s hairpin deadlines."},{"_id":"CGFVLTE7ZNEORBV4TICCRWOG54","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Gov. Josh Shapiro and Sen. Dave McCormick worked with the Pennsylvania State University, the Keystone Space Collaborative (KSC), and Pittsburgh International to sell Pittsburgh, and Pennsylvania at large, as the nation’s next space hub. The commonwealth pledged $85 million to support the academy’s construction and transportation needs, alongside a commitment to raise $200 million in private endowment, according to Shapiro’s office."},{"_id":"ZJUSSSRNLNHUXMTE72ELTJACCI","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Scouting proposals for the academy is a NASA-led effort, and the space agency is working on an ambitious timeline, specifically, “a groundbreaking no later than 2027, temporarily hosting the first 300 students in 2028, and a permanent location in operation by 2031,” <a href=\"https://www.nasa.gov/news-release/president-trump-signs-executive-order-to-create-us-space-academy/\" rel=\"\">according to NASA’s announcement</a>."},{"_id":"VBJXS2GFKFGGRJIEFPCTJNYDEE","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Beyond the slew of research universities and deep manufacturing and innovation roots that run through the Steel City, Pittsburgh also has the land: the Southfield Business Park next to the airport with its 300 acres of available space. Gov. Josh Shapiro’s office set out a plan to hit all the deadlines — a 2027 groundbreaking at Southfield, an interim campus for roughly 300 students to begin instruction in 2028, and a permanent campus for 1,200 students by Fall 2031, with the potential to support up to 4,000 students, according to the <a href=\"https://www.pa.gov/governor/newsroom/2026-press-releases/gov--shapiro--sen--mccormick--penn-state-submit-proposal-to-host\" rel=\"\">governor’s Monday announcement</a>."},{"_id":"HHKWYVPAOZEJNOVMCQHNSDQ4NU","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"As Southfield is built out, the<a href=\"https://www.post-gazette.com/business/development/2024/06/10/pittsburgh-technical-college-closure-accrediting-students/stories/202406100110/\" rel=\"\"> former Pittsburgh Technical College</a> in North Fayette Township can house up to 384 students, and “existing laboratory and classroom space [will] ensure the Academy gets off the ground immediately” in 2028. After construction near the airport is complete, the governor said the former technical college can become a “USSA Innovation District” to supplement the permanent campus with a residential village and additional lab and testing facilities."},{"_id":"MPQXMGFYQZDU5HHMWVOVV4DG7Y","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Pennsylvania has a considerable footprint in the space race."},{"_id":"EBFCAZSR2VGCBIOZ77IKVCMZHI","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"In fact, the Pennsylvania space economy “generated $8.6 billion in economic impact over the last four fiscal years and supports 556 businesses across the space supply chain,” according to Shapiro’s announcement."},{"_id":"5PTZU67VDRBFRD5R2BJEFUFP74","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"And the Steel City is no stranger to space either."},{"_id":"3SSLI4NX5VGF5C7K3GD6TCQLUY","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“The Pittsburgh region alone is home to 126 of these businesses, spanning engineering, research and testing, software and computing, advanced machinery and equipment manufacturing, academia, spacecraft, power systems, and propulsion.”"},{"_id":"3I2X47VOFBCIJDEMBA6F67WKDA","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Voyager, <a href=\"https://www.post-gazette.com/business/tech-news/2026/07/13/astrobotic-sale-to-colorado-s-voyager-is-complete/stories/202607130027/\" rel=\"\">formerly Astrobotic</a>, is preparing for <a href=\"https://www.post-gazette.com/business/tech-news/2026/10/14/griffin-lunar-lander-passes-inspections-nasa-astrobotic-voyager/stories/202610130046/\" rel=\"\">a moonshot later this year</a> with a rover built by engineers in its North Shore headquarters. The University of Pittsburgh launched Pitt Space in 2024 and earlier this year, launched the <a href=\"https://www.post-gazette.com/news/education/2026/01/30/pitt-trivedi-institute-space-health/stories/202601290103/\" rel=\"\">Trivedi Institute for Space and Global Biomedicine</a> to improve human health on Earth using insights from spaceflight. Carnegie Mellon University researchers regularly build robotics meant to advance space exploration."},{"_id":"G6523KL57VCFVJ3KF2TSLTTXIY","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“Pennsylvania has the rare combination of world-class research universities, a deep industrial and defense manufacturing base, extraordinary robotics and AI capabilities, and a legacy of building the technologies that move our nation forward,” said Justine Kasznica, founder and board chair of the Keystone Space Collaborative. "},{"_id":"JYY7GW7C5BAINK3EQTT57JAUVE","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“Through the Keystone Space Collaborative, we have spent years connecting these assets into a regional space economy. This proposal demonstrates that Pennsylvania is ready to turn that ecosystem into a national asset — and that the Academy can give NASA and the nation a powerful new constituency of talent, industry, and bipartisan support for American leadership in space.”"},{"_id":"FUV4P2TPBRBLLEUUJGBOPCMJQU","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"A certain Pennsylvania resident and NASA leader confirmed the notion during the Keystone Space Collaborative’s annual conference in October: This is the place for space."},{"_id":"4U26XGSRVNHAXMUABZWUCWVZLQ","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“The demand and opportunity for Pennsylvania, Ohio and West Virginia is already here,” NASA strength required for missions NASA has been entrusted to achieve.”"},{"_id":"XV75AZJSNFAKFFSBCIJYYYL3TU","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"In response to a Post-Gazette inquiry,
